Implement the following plan:

# Sonderauswertung (Special Reports) — Date Range Aggregated Stats

## Context
The app has per-exercise reports at `/exercises/:id/reports`. The user wants a new report type that accumulates data across a date range (quarterly, yearly, custom). It should show the same visualizations (map, charts, tables) but aggregated across all exercises in the range, with the timespan displayed at the top. Accessible via a dedicated nav link.

## Changes

### 1. Server: Aggregated Stats Endpoint
**`server/src/routes/reports.ts`** — replace placeholder

New endpoint: `GET /api/v1/reports/stats?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD`

- Fetch exercises in date range, collect their IDs
- Run the same 5 SQL queries as `exercises/:id/stats` but with `WHERE sr.exercise_id IN (?,?,...)` instead of single exercise filter
- `totalParticipants`: COUNT(DISTINCT operator_id) — deduplicates across exercises
- `totalReports`, `perRepeater`, `bezirkStats`, `blStats`, `participants`: same pattern
- Returns: `{ exercises[], stats: { totalParticipants, totalReports, perRepeater[], bezirkStats[], blStats[], participants[] } }`

### 2. Shared Types
**`client/src/types/stats.ts`** — NEW

Extract interfaces from ReportsPage.tsx (lines 16-54): `BezirkStat`, `BlStat`, `Participant`, `RepeaterStat`, `Stats`. Both pages import from here.

### 3. New Page
**`client/src/pages/AggregatedReportsPage.tsx`** — NEW

- Quick-select buttons: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Jahr (current year)
- Two date inputs (Von / Bis) for custom range
- Timespan header: "01.01.2026 – 31.03.2026 · 12 Übungen"
- Summary cards: Teilnehmer (unique), Rapporte, Übungen, Ø Teilnehmer/Übung
- Collapsible exercise list (date, name, individual counts)
- AustriaMap, bar chart, pie chart, bezirk table, participant list (same as ReportsPage)
- PNG export button

### 4. Route + Navigation
**`client/src/App.tsx`** — add `<Route path="reports" element={<AggregatedReportsPage />} />`

**`client/src/components/Layout.tsx`** — add "Auswertung" nav link (desktop + mobile)

### 5. Refactor ReportsPage
**`client/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx`** — import shared types from `client/src/types/stats.ts`

## Files
| File | Action |
|------|--------|
| `server/src/routes/reports.ts` | Replace placeholder with aggregated stats endpoint |
| `client/src/types/stats.ts` | NEW — shared interfaces |
| `client/src/pages/AggregatedReportsPage.tsx` | NEW — main page |
| `client/src/App.tsx` | Add route |
| `client/src/components/Layout.tsx` | Add nav link |
| `client/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx` | Use shared types |

## Verification
1. `nix-shell -p nodejs --run "npm run build"` compiles
2. Quick-select buttons (Q1–Q4, Jahr) fetch correct aggregated data
3. Custom date range works
4. Map, charts, tables render correctly with multi-exercise data
5. Empty state shows when no exercises in range
6. Deploy to production

     1→import { Router } from 'express';
     2→import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
     3→import { getDb } from '../db/database.js';
     4→import { AuthRequest, requireRole } from '../middleware/auth.js';
     5→
     6→export const exercisesRouter = Router();
     7→
     8→// List all exercises with summary stats
     9→exercisesRouter.get('/', (_req, res) => {
    10→  const db = getDb();
    11→  const exercises = db.prepare(`
    12→    SELECT e.id, e.date, e.name, e.notes, e.oe_link_enabled,
    13→      (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT operator_id) FROM signal_reports WHERE exercise_id = e.id AND is_op_marker = 0) as participant_count,
    14→      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signal_reports WHERE exercise_id = e.id AND is_op_marker = 0 AND readability IS NOT NULL) as report_count
    15→    FROM exercises e ORDER BY e.date ASC
    16→  `).all();
    17→  res.json(exercises);
    18→});
    19→
    20→// Create exercise (admin only)
    21→exercisesRouter.post('/', requireRole('admin'), (req, res) => {
    22→  const { date, name, oe_link_enabled } = req.body;
    23→  if (!date || !name) {
    24→    res.status(400).json({ error: 'Datum und Name erforderlich' });
    25→    return;
    26→  }
    27→  const db = getDb();
    28→  const id = randomUUID();
    29→  db.prepare('INSERT INTO exercises (id, date, name, oe_link_enabled) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)').run(id, date, name, oe_link_enabled !== undefined ? (oe_link_enabled ? 1 : 0) : 1);
    30→  const exercise = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM exercises WHERE id = ?').get(id);
    31→  res.status(201).json(exercise);
    32→});
    33→
    34→// Get full exercise with reports
    35→exercisesRouter.get('/:id', (req, res) => {
    36→  const db = getDb();
    37→  const exercise = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM exercises WHERE id = ?').get(req.params.id);
    38→  if (!exercise) {
    39→    res.status(404).json({ error: 'Übung nicht gefunden' });
    40→    return;
    41→  }
    42→
    43→  const repeaters = db.prepare(`
    44→    SELECT er.*, r.short_name, r.site_name, r.band, r.callsign as repeater_callsign,
    45→      r.frequency_mhz, r.offset_mhz, r.ctcss_hz, r.burst_hz, r.type, r.is_linked,
    46→      r.bundesland_code, bl.name as bundesland_name
    47→    FROM exercise_repeaters er
    48→    JOIN repeaters r ON r.id = er.repeater_id
    49→    LEFT JOIN bundeslaender bl ON bl.code = r.bundesland_code
    50→    WHERE er.exercise_id = ?
    51→    ORDER BY r.bundesland_code, r.sort_order
    52→  `).all(req.params.id);
    53→
    54→  const reports = db.prepare(`
    55→    SELECT sr.*, o.callsign, o.name as operator_name, o.bezirk_code, o.bundesland_code,
    56→      r.short_name as repeater_name, r.bundesland_code as repeater_bundesland_code,
    57→      ep.abbreviation as einstiegspunkt_abbr, ep.site_name as einstiegspunkt_name
    58→    FROM signal_reports sr
    59→    JOIN operators o ON o.id = sr.operator_id
    60→    JOIN repeaters r ON r.id = sr.repeater_id
    61→    LEFT JOIN einstiegspunkte ep ON ep.id = sr.einstiegspunkt_id
    62→    WHERE sr.exercise_id = ?
    63→    ORDER BY r.bundesland_code, o.callsign
    64→  `).all(req.params.id);
    65→
    66→  const attendance = db.prepare(`
    67→    SELECT ea.*, o.callsign, o.name as operator_name, o.bezirk_code, o.bundesland_code
    68→    FROM exercise_attendance ea
    69→    JOIN operators o ON o.id = ea.operator_id
    70→    WHERE ea.exercise_id = ?
    71→    ORDER BY o.callsign

     1→export async function getOrCreateOperator(callsign: string, existing: any): Promise<any> {
     2→  if (existing) return existing;
     3→  if (!callsign || callsign.length < 3) return null;
     4→  try {
     5→    return await apiFetch('/api/v1/operators', {
     6→      method: 'POST',
     7→      body: JSON.stringify({ callsign: callsign.toUpperCase() }),
     8→    });
     9→  } catch (err: any) {
    10→    if (err.message?.includes('existiert')) {
    11→      const results = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators?q=${encodeURIComponent(callsign)}`);
    12→      return results.find((o: any) => o.callsign === callsign.toUpperCase()) || results[0] || null;
    13→    }
    14→    return null;
    15→  }
    16→}
    17→
    18→export async function apiFetch(url: string, options?: RequestInit) {
    19→  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    20→  const res = await fetch(url, {
    21→    ...options,
    22→    headers: {
    23→      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    24→      ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
    25→      ...options?.headers,
    26→    },
    27→  });
    28→  if (res.status === 401) {
    29→    localStorage.removeItem('token');
    30→    localStorage.removeItem('admin');
    31→    window.location.href = '/login';
    32→    throw new Error('Unauthorized');
    33→  }
    34→  if (!res.ok) {
    35→    const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: 'Fehler' }));
    36→    throw new Error(err.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
    37→  }
    38→  return res.json();
    39→}

sr.operator_id) as participants,\n      COUNT(CASE WHEN sr.readability IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as reports\n    FROM signal_reports sr\n    JOIN operators o ON o.id = sr.operator_id\n    JOIN bezirke bz ON bz.code = o.bezirk_code\n    JOIN bundeslaender bl ON bl.code = bz.bundesland_code\n    WHERE sr.exercise_id IN (${placeholders}) AND sr.is_op_marker = 0\n    GROUP BY bz.code\n    ORDER BY bl.sort_order, bz.code`\n  ).all(...ids);\n\n  const blStats = db.prepare(\n    `SELECT\n      COALESCE(bl.name, 'Sonstige') as bundesland,\n      o.bundesland_code,\n      COUNT(DISTINCT sr.operator_id) as participants,\n      COUNT(CASE WHEN sr.readability IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as reports\n    FROM signal_reports sr\n    JOIN operators o ON o.id = sr.operator_id\n    LEFT JOIN bundeslaender bl ON bl.code = o.bundesland_code\n    WHERE sr.exercise_id IN (${placeholders}) AND sr.is_op_marker = 0\n    GROUP BY o.bundesland_code\n    ORDER BY o.bundesland_code`\n  ).all(...ids);\n\n  const participants = db.prepare(\n    `SELECT o.callsign, o.name, o.bezirk_code, o.bundesland_code,\n      bl.name as bundesland_name,\n      COUNT(CASE WHEN sr.readability IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as report_count\n    FROM signal_reports sr\n    JOIN operators o ON o.id = sr.operator_id\n    LEFT JOIN bundeslaender bl ON bl.code = o.bundesland_code\n    WHERE sr.exercise_id IN (${placeholders}) AND sr.is_op_marker = 0\n    GROUP BY sr.operator_id\n    ORDER BY bl.sort_order, o.bezirk_code, o.callsign`\n  ).all(...ids);\n\n  res.json({\n    exercises,\n    stats: { totalParticipants, totalReports, perRepeater, bezirkStats, blStats, participants },\n  });\n});\n\n// Placeholder fallback\nreportsRouter.get('/', (_req, res) => {\n  res.json({ message: 'Use /api/v1/reports/stats?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD' });\n});\n"

> AGENT

All tasks completed. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

**1. Shared types** (`client/src/types/stats.ts`) — Extracted `BezirkStat`, `BlStat`, `Participant`, `RepeaterStat`, and `Stats` interfaces, shared by both report pages.

**2. Aggregated stats endpoint** (`server/src/routes/reports.ts`) — `GET /api/v1/reports/stats?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD` fetches exercises in the date range, then runs the same 5 SQL queries as the per-exercise stats but with `WHERE exercise_id IN (...)` for aggregation. Returns `{ exercises[], stats }`.

**3. AggregatedReportsPage** (`client/src/pages/AggregatedReportsPage.tsx`) — New page with:
   - Quick-select buttons: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, and full year
   - Custom date range inputs (Von / Bis)
   - Timespan header showing date range and exercise count
   - Summary cards: Teilnehmer (unique), Rapporte, Übungen, Ø Teilnehmer/Übung
   - Per-repeater report counts
   - Collapsible exercise list with per-exercise breakdown
   - AustriaMap, bar chart, pie chart, bezirk table, participant list
   - PNG export (full page and individual charts)
   - Empty state when no exercises found

**4. Route + Navigation** — Added `/reports` route in `App.tsx` and "Auswertung" nav link in `Layout.tsx` (both desktop and mobile).

**5. ReportsPage refactored** to import shared types from `types/stats.ts`.

Build compiles successfully with no errors.

+  const ids = exercises.map((e: any) => e.id);
+  const placeholders = ids.map(() => '?').join(',');

+  const totalReports = (db.prepare(

+

+    GROUP BY sr.repeater_id
+    ORDER BY count DESC`
+  ).all(...ids);
+

+      COUNT(CASE WHEN sr.readability IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as reports
+    FROM signal_reports sr
+    JOIN operators o ON o.id = sr.operator_id
+    JOIN bezirke bz ON bz.code = o.bezirk_code
+    JOIN bundeslaender bl ON bl.code = bz.bundesland_code
+    WHERE sr.exercise_id IN (${placeholders}) AND sr.is_op_marker = 0
+    GROUP BY bz.code

+      COUNT(CASE WHEN sr.readability IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as reports
+    FROM signal_reports sr
+    JOIN operators o ON o.id = sr.operator_id
+    LEFT JOIN bundeslaender bl ON bl.code = o.bundesland_code
+    WHERE sr.exercise_id IN (${placeholders}) AND sr.is_op_marker = 0
+    GROUP BY o.bundesland_code
+    ORDER BY o.bundesland_code`
+  ).all(...ids);
+

+    WHERE sr.exercise_id IN (${placeholders}) AND sr.is_op_marker = 0
+    GROUP BY sr.operator_id
+    ORDER BY bl.sort_order, o.bezirk_code, o.callsign`
+  ).all(...ids);
+

> AGENT

The issue is `fcntl64: symbol not found` — the `better-sqlite3` native module was compiled on the host (glibc) but the Alpine Docker image uses musl. The native addon needs to be rebuilt inside the Alpine container. This is a pre-existing deployment issue unrelated to our changes.

The fix is to rebuild `better-sqlite3` in the Docker build stage. Let me add the necessary build tools:

> TOOL

The builder stage is Alpine but doesn't have build tools for native modules. I need to add `python3`, `make`, and `g++` so `better-sqlite3` compiles against musl.

  "new_string": "# Multi-stage build\nFROM node:20-alpine AS builder\nRUN apk add --no-cache python3 make g++\nWORKDIR /app\n\n# Install root deps\nCOPY package*.json ./\nRUN npm ci\n\n# Install server deps\nCOPY server/package*.json ./server/\nRUN cd server && npm ci --build-from-source"

    10→# Load environment variables

    16→    exit 1

    19→# Validate required variables

    21→for var in $REQUIRED_VARS; do
    22→    if [ -z "${!var}" ]; then
    23→        echo -e "${RED}Error: $var is not set in .env.production${NC}"
    24→        exit 1
    25→    fi
    26→done

    30→if [ "$1" == "--rebuild" ]; then

    32→    echo -e "${YELLOW}Rebuild flag set — will build without cache${NC}"

    35→echo -e "${GREEN}=== Deploying BOS-ARSA Log to $DEPLOY_HOST ===${NC}"
    36→echo "Host: $DEPLOY_HOST"

    39→echo "Port: $CONTAINER_PORT"
    40→echo ""
    41→
    42→# Step 1: Sync code to remote host
    43→echo -e "${GREEN}Step 1: Syncing code...${NC}"
    44→GIT_URL=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    45→ssh "$DEPLOY_HOST" "
    46→    if [ -d '$REMOTE_DIR' ]; then
    47→        cd '$REMOTE_DIR' && git pull
    48→    else
    49→        mkdir -p '$(dirname $REMOTE_DIR)'
    50→        git clone '$GIT_URL' '$REMOTE_DIR'
    51→    fi
    52→"
    53→
    54→# Step 2: Copy .env for docker compose
    55→echo -e "${GREEN}Step 2: Copying environment config...${NC}"
    56→ssh "$DEPLOY_HOST" "cat > '$REMOTE_DIR/.env' << 'ENVEOF'

    58→ENVEOF"
    59→
    60→# Step 3: Build Docker image on remote

    62→ssh "$DEPLOY_HOST" "
    63→    cd '$REMOTE_DIR'
    64→    docker build $REBUILD_FLAG -t '$IMAGE_NAME' .
    65→"
    66→
    67→# Step 4: Restart container (volume is preserved — data persists)
    68→echo -e "${GREEN}Step 4: Restarting container...${NC}"
    69→ssh "$DEPLOY_HOST" "
    70→    cd '$REMOTE_DIR'
    71→    docker compose up -d --force-recreate --build
    72→"
    73→
    74→# Step 5: Verify deployment
    75→echo -e "${GREEN}Step 5: Verifying deployment...${NC}"
    76→sleep 3
    77→
    78→# Check container status

    80→echo "Container status: $CONTAINER_STATUS"
    81→
    82→# Check local port

    84→if ssh "$DEPLOY_HOST" "curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:$LOCAL_PORT/api/v1/auth/login"; then
    85→    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Container is running on port $LOCAL_PORT${NC}"

     1→# BOS-ARSA Log
     2→
     3→**Amateurfunk Notfunkübung — Live-Erfassung, Multi-User, Auswertung**
     4→
     5→A real-time, multi-user web application for BOS-ARSA amateur radio exercises across Austria. Multiple operators simultaneously log signal reports from ~100 ham radio stations on repeaters and direct frequencies. BOS-ARSA Log replaces the shared Excel workbook and standalone HTML prototypes with a single unified tool.
     6→
     7→Part of the [oeradio.at](https://oeradio.at) ecosystem.
     8→
     9→## Tech Stack
    10→
    11→| Layer | Technology |
    12→|-------|-----------|
    13→| Frontend | React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Socket.IO client |
    14→| Backend | Node.js, Express, TypeScript, Socket.IO server |
    15→| Database | SQLite via better-sqlite3 |
    16→| Auth | Username/password with bcrypt + JWT tokens |
    17→| Security | Helmet, rate limiting, CORS restriction, non-root Docker |
    18→| Deployment | Docker, Docker Compose, Cloudflare Tunnel |
    19→
    20→## Architecture
    21→
    22→```
    23→/client          React SPA (Vite)
    24→/server          Express API + WebSocket server
    25→/data            SQLite database (Docker volume-mounted)
    26→```
    27→
    28→- RESTful API for CRUD operations, WebSocket (Socket.IO) for real-time sync between concurrent users
    29→- Server serves the built client in production
    30→- SQLite keeps deployment simple — the data volume is small (~1,000 operators, ~200 reports/week)
    31→
    32→## Key Domain Concepts
    33→
    34→| Concept | Description |
    35→|---------|-------------|
    36→| **Operator (Rufzeichen)** | Ham radio callsign, e.g. OE8YML, S55UJE |
    37→| **Repeater/Umsetzer** | Radio relay station with TX frequency, offset, CTCSS |
    38→| **Linked Repeater** | One logical repeater spanning multiple physical sites (Einstiegspunkte) |
    39→| **Einstiegspunkt** | Physical entry point in a linked repeater network, e.g. Hermannskogel (HK) |
    40→| **Signal Report (Rapport)** | RST format, e.g. "5/9+30 HK" = R5 / S9+30dB via Hermannskogel |
    41→| **Exercise (Übung)** | One session with configured repeaters and collected reports |
    42→| **Bezirk** | Austrian political district, identified by 2-3 letter code |
    43→| **Bundesland** | Austrian state (OE1=Wien through OE9=Vorarlberg) |
    44→| **Nachbarland** | Neighbor country (SI, CZ, DE, IT, SK, HR, LI, CH, HU) |
    45→
    46→## Features
    47→
    48→### Two Data Entry Modes
    49→
    50→- **Frequenzen (Land)** — Repeater-first entry. Select a repeater, enter reports grouped by Bezirk.
    51→- **OE-Link (Bund)** — Geography-first entry. Bundesland/Bezirk hierarchy with linked repeater selection per district. Only available when OE-Link mode is enabled for the exercise.
    52→
    53→### Exercise Setup
    54→
    55→- Bundesland selection grid (OE1–OE9) with one-click activation of all repeaters per state
    56→- ~80 pre-configured Austrian repeaters from OEVSV data
    57→- Custom repeater and simplex frequency creation
    58→- OE-Link toggle for linked repeater mode
    59→- Per-repeater operator (OP) callsign assignment
    60→
    61→### Interactive Austria Map with Neighbor Countries
    62→
    63→- Choropleth map of Austria (OE1–OE9) with participant/report density
    64→- 9 neighbor countries displayed: Germany, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, Slovenia, Italy, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Croatia
    65→- High-resolution borders from Natural Earth 10m data
    66→- Countries with participating operators are color-coded by activity level
    67→- Hover tooltips showing participant count and report count per region
    68→
    69→### Automatic Callsign-to-Country Assignment
    70→
    71→- Foreign callsign prefixes automatically mapped to the correct country (e.g. S55UJE → Slovenia, DL1ABC → Germany)
    72→- Supported prefixes: OE1–OE9, S5 (Slovenia), OK/OL (Czech Republic), DA-DR (Germany), I (Italy), OM (Slovakia), 9A (Croatia), HB0 (Liechtenstein), HB (Switzerland), HA/HG (Hungary)
    73→- Strips portable/mobile suffixes (/P, /M, /OE8) before matching
    74→- Auto-derived on operator creation; existing operators backfilled via migration
    75→
    76→### Live Multi-User
    77→
    78→- Socket.IO real-time sync — reports entered by one user appear instantly for all others
    79→- Running totals bar always visible: participant count, total reports, per-repeater counts
    80→- Optimized for speed: autofocus, enter-to-submit, auto-uppercase, keyboard shortcuts
    81→
    82→### Keyboard Shortcuts
    83→
    84→| Shortcut | Action |
    85→|----------|--------|
    86→| `Alt+1` through `Alt+9` | Insert "5/1" through "5/9" in rapport field |
    87→| `Ctrl+1` through `Ctrl+9` | Insert "OE1" through "OE9" in callsign field |
    88→| `Enter` | Submit report and clear fields |
    89→| `Arrow Up/Down` | Navigate autocomplete suggestions |
    90→| `Escape` | Close autocomplete dropdown |
    91→
    92→### Reports & Export
    93→
    94→- Exercise summary with per-repeater and per-Bezirk/Bundesland/Land breakdown
    95→- Interactive Austria map with neighbor countries showing participant distribution
    96→- Bar chart (stations vs. reports) and pie chart (distribution by Bundesland/Land)
    97→- Participants list with callsign, name, location, report count
    98→- Export formats:
    99→  - **PNG** — Full-page screenshot of the analytics view
   100→  - **TXT OE-Link** — Bundesland-grouped text export
   101→  - **TXT Frequenzen** — Repeater-grouped text export
   102→  - **TXT Kombiniert** — Summary statistics with per-repeater breakdown
   103→
   104→### Operator Registry
   105→
   106→- Searchable operator database (callsign, name, QTH)
   107→- Quick-add during live entry when callsign not found
   108→- Inline editing of operator details
   109→- Paginated browsing (50 per page)
   110→
   111→### Security
   112→
   113→- Helmet security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options)
   114→- Rate limiting on login (10 attempts per 15 minutes)
   115→- CORS restricted to configured origin
   116→- JWT secret fail-fast in production
   117→- Request body size limit (1MB)
   118→- Input length validation
   119→- Docker container runs as non-root user
   120→- Port bound to localhost only (Cloudflare tunnel access)
   121→
   122→### User Roles
   123→
   124→| Capability | Admin | Erfasser |
   125→|-----------|-------|----------|
   126→| Create exercises | ✓ | — |
   127→| Configure repeaters | ✓ | — |
   128→| Change exercise name/date | ✓ | — |
   129→| Enable OE-Link | ✓ | — |
   130→| Enter/edit/delete reports | ✓ | ✓ |
   131→| Manage operators | ✓ | ✓ |
   132→| View analytics & export | ✓ | ✓ |
   133→
   134→## Getting Started
   135→
   136→### Prerequisites
   137→
   138→- Node.js 20+
   139→- npm
   140→
   141→### Development
   142→
   143→```bash
   144→# Install dependencies
   145→npm install
   146→cd server && npm install && cd ..
   147→cd client && npm install && cd ..
   148→
   149→# Seed the database with reference data (idempotent — safe to run multiple times)
   150→npm run db:seed
   151→
   152→# Start both client and server in dev mode
   153→npm run dev
   154→```
   155→
   156→The client runs on `http://localhost:5173` with API proxy to `http://localhost:3000`.
   157→
   158→### Production (Docker)
   159→
   160→```bash
   161→# Build and run
   162→docker compose up -d
   163→
   164→# Seed database (first run only — idempotent, won't overwrite existing data)
   165→docker exec bosarsalog node dist/server/db/seed.js
   166→```
   167→
   168→Required environment variables:
   169→
   170→| Variable | Description |
   171→|----------|-------------|
   172→| `JWT_SECRET` | Random 64+ char secret (required in production) |
   173→| `CORS_ORIGIN` | Allowed origin URL (default: `https://bosarsalog.oeradio.at`) |
   174→| `DATABASE_PATH` | SQLite DB path (default: `/data/bosarsalog.db`) |
   175→
   176→## API
   177→
   178→All endpoints are prefixed with `/api/v1/`. Protected routes require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
   179→
   180→### Auth
   181→
   182→```
   183→POST /api/v1/auth/login    { username, password } -> { token, admin }
   184→```
   185→
   186→### Exercises
   187→
   188→```
   189→GET    /api/v1/exercises              List all (with summary stats)
   190→POST   /api/v1/exercises              Create { date, name }
   191→GET    /api/v1/exercises/:id          Full exercise with reports
   192→PATCH  /api/v1/exercises/:id          Update (name, organisator, oe_link)
   193→GET    /api/v1/exercises/:id/stats    Live statistics
   194→GET    /api/v1/exercises/:id/reports  All signal reports
   195→POST   /api/v1/exercises/:id/reports  Create report
   196→PATCH  /api/v1/exercises/:id/reports/:rid  Edit report
   197→DELETE /api/v1/exercises/:id/reports/:rid  Delete report
   198→```
   199→
   200→### Exercise Repeaters
   201→
   202→```
   203→GET    /api/v1/exercises/:id/repeaters
   204→POST   /api/v1/exercises/:id/repeaters      Activate repeater
   205→PATCH  /api/v1/exercises/:id/repeaters/:rid  Update OP assignment
   206→DELETE /api/v1/exercises/:id/repeaters/:rid  Deactivate repeater
   207→```
   208→
   209→### Operators
   210→
   211→```
   212→GET    /api/v1/operators         List/search (?q= for autocomplete)
   213→POST   /api/v1/operators         Quick-add new operator
   214→GET    /api/v1/operators/:id     Full profile with history
   215→PATCH  /api/v1/operators/:id     Update operator
   216→```
   217→
   218→### Reference Data
   219→
   220→```
   221→GET /api/v1/reference/bundeslaender
   222→GET /api/v1/reference/bezirke
   223→GET /api/v1/reference/einstiegspunkte
   224→GET /api/v1/repeaters
   225→GET /api/v1/repeaters/:id/einstiegspunkte
   226→```
   227→
   228→### Export
   229→
   230→```
   231→GET /api/v1/export/exercises/:id/bund      TXT (Bundesland-grouped)
   232→GET /api/v1/export/exercises/:id/land      TXT (Repeater-grouped)
   233→GET /api/v1/export/exercises/:id/combined  Summary report
   234→```
   235→
   236→### WebSocket Events (Socket.IO)
   237→
   238→```
   239→Client -> Server:
   240→  join_exercise      { exercise_id }
   241→  leave_exercise     { exercise_id }
   242→  report_created     { report data }
   243→  report_updated     { report data }
   244→  report_deleted     { report_id }
   245→  attendance_updated { attendance data }
   246→
   247→Server -> Client (broadcast):
   248→  report_created     { report, entered_by }
   249→  report_updated     { report, entered_by }
   250→  report_deleted     { report_id, entered_by }
   251→  attendance_updated { attendance, entered_by }
   252→```
   253→
   254→## Seed Data
   255→
   256→The seed script (`npm run db:seed`) is **idempotent** — it only inserts data if the tables are empty, and never deletes existing data. It populates:
   257→
   258→- **18 Bundesländer** — 9 Austrian states + 9 international entries
   259→- **84 Bezirke** — Austrian political districts with capital flags
   260→- **~80 Repeaters** — Comprehensive OEVSV data across OE1–OE9 plus international and simplex
   261→- **12 Einstiegspunkte** — Entry points for the Magdalensberg linked system
   262→- **2 Users** — Admin and operator accounts
   263→
   264→## Conventions
   265→

    34→export default function LandMode({ exerciseId, repeaters, reports, onReportCreated, onReportUpdated, onReportDeleted }: Props) {
    35→  const [collapsedReps, setCollapsedReps] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
    36→  const [opCallsigns, setOpCallsigns] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
    37→  const [bezirke, setBezirke] = useState<any[]>([]);

    39→  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '' });
    40→
    41→  // Load bezirke + OP callsigns
    42→  useEffect(() => {
    43→    Promise.all([
    44→      apiFetch('/api/v1/reference/bezirke'),
    45→      apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/repeaters`),
    46→    ]).then(([bz, exReps]) => {
    47→      setBezirke(bz);
    48→      const ops: Record<number, string> = {};
    49→      for (const er of exReps) {
    50→        if (er.operator_callsign) {
    51→          ops[er.repeater_id] = er.operator_callsign;
    52→        }
    53→      }

    57→
    58→  // Group repeaters by Bundesland — exclude linked repeaters (those belong to BundMode)
    59→  const repeatersByBl: Record<string, any[]> = {};
    60→  const simplexRepeaters: any[] = [];
    61→  for (const r of repeaters) {
    62→    if (r.is_linked) continue;
    63→    if (r.type === 'simplex') {
    64→      simplexRepeaters.push(r);
    65→    } else {
    66→      const blCode = r.bundesland_code || '_other';
    67→      if (!repeatersByBl[blCode]) repeatersByBl[blCode] = [];
    68→      repeatersByBl[blCode].push(r);
    69→    }
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  const sortedBlCodes = Object.keys(repeatersByBl).sort((a, b) => {
    73→    if (a === '_other') return 1;
    74→    if (b === '_other') return -1;
    75→    return a.localeCompare(b);
    76→  });

    96→      });
    97→    }

   102→    if (!match) return { readability: null, strength: null, db_over_s9: null };
   103→    return {

   351→interface BezirkRowProps {

   366→function BezirkRow({ bezirk, reports, linkedRepeaters, defaultRepeaterId, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: BezirkRowProps) {
   367→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '' });
   368→  const [repeaterId, setRepeaterId] = useState(defaultRepeaterId);
   369→  const callsignRef = useRef<CallsignInputRef>(null);
   370→
   371→  useEffect(() => {
   372→    if (defaultRepeaterId && !repeaterId) setRepeaterId(defaultRepeaterId);
   373→  }, [defaultRepeaterId]);
   374→
   375→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   376→    e.preventDefault();
   377→    if (!form.callsign && !form.operator) return;
   378→    if (!repeaterId) return;
   379→    onSubmit(repeaterId, form);
   380→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '' });
   381→    setTimeout(() => callsignRef.current?.focus(), 50);
   382→  };
   383→
   384→  return (
   385→    <div className="px-2 sm:px-3 py-1.5">
   386→      {bezirk.code !== '??' && (
   387→        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 mb-1">
   388→          <span className={`text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white ${bezirk.is_capital ? 'bg-[#dc3545]' : 'bg-[#6c757d]'}`}>
   389→            {bezirk.code}
   390→          </span>
   391→          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 truncate">{bezirk.name}</span>
   392→          {reports.length > 0 && <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0">({reports.length})</span>}
   393→        </div>
   394→      )}
   395→
   396→      {reports.length > 0 && (
   397→        <table className="w-full text-xs mb-1">
   398→          <tbody>
   399→            {reports.map((r, idx) => (
   400→              <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-blue-50 group">

   406→                      <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="Sonst." className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20" />
   407→                      <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>

   417→                    </td>

   419→                    <td className="py-0.5 w-4">

   430→      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">

   470→        />
   471→        <button type="submit" title="Rapport speichern (Enter)" className="bg-[#c8102e] hover:bg-[#a00d24] text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs flex-shrink-0">

    32→    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    33→    if (q.length < 1) { setSuggestions([]); setShowSuggestions(false); return; }
    34→    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
    35→      try {
    36→        const results = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`);
    37→        setSuggestions(results);
    38→        setShowSuggestions(results.length > 0);
    39→        setSelectedIdx(-1);
    40→      } catch {}
    41→    }, 150);
    42→  };
    43→
    44→  const handleChange = (val: string) => {
    45→    const upper = val.toUpperCase();
    46→    onChange(upper);
    47→    search(upper);
    48→  };
    49→
    50→  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    51→    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    52→      e.preventDefault();
    53→      setSelectedIdx(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, suggestions.length - 1));
    54→    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    55→      e.preventDefault();
    56→      setSelectedIdx(prev => Math.max(prev - 1, -1));
    57→    } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && selectedIdx >= 0) {
    58→      e.preventDefault();
    59→      selectSuggestion(suggestions[selectedIdx]);
    60→    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    61→      setShowSuggestions(false);
    62→    }
    63→    // Keyboard shortcuts
    64→    if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
    65→      e.preventDefault();
    66→      onChange(value + `5/${e.key}`);
    67→    }
    68→    if (e.ctrlKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
    69→      e.preventDefault();
    70→      onChange(`OE${e.key}`);
    71→    }
    72→  };
    73→
    74→  const selectSuggestion = (op: any) => {
    75→    onChange(op.callsign);
    76→    onSelect(op);
    77→    setShowSuggestions(false);
    78→    setSuggestions([]);
    79→  };
    80→
    81→  return (
    82→    <div className="relative">
    83→      <input
    84→        ref={inputRef}
    85→        type="text"
    86→        value={value}
    87→        onChange={e => handleChange(e.target.value)}
    88→        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
    89→        onBlur={() => setTimeout(() => setShowSuggestions(false), 200)}
    90→        onFocus={() => { if (suggestions.length > 0) setShowSuggestions(true); }}
    91→        className={`border border-gray-300 rounded px-2 py-1 font-mono uppercase text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 ${className || 'w-32'}`}
    92→        placeholder="Rufzeichen"
    93→      />
    94→      {showSuggestions && (
    95→        <div className="absolute z-20 top-full left-0 mt-1 bg-white border rounded shadow-lg max-h-48 overflow-auto w-64 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)]">
    96→          {suggestions.map((op, i) => (
    97→            <div
    98→              key={op.id}
    99→              onMouseDown={() => selectSuggestion(op)}
   100→              className={`px-3 py-1.5 cursor-pointer text-sm ${i === selectedIdx ? 'bg-blue-100' : 'hover:bg-gray-100'}`}
   101→            >
   102→              <span className="font-mono font-bold">{op.callsign}</span>
   103→              {op.name && <span className="ml-2 text-gray-500">{op.name}</span>}
   104→              {op.bezirk_code && <span className="ml-1 text-xs bg-gray-200 rounded px-1">{op.bezirk_code}</span>}
   105→              {op.bundesland_name && <span className="ml-1 text-xs text-gray-400">{op.bundesland_name}</span>}
   106→              {op.total_reports > 0 && <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-blue-500">{op.total_reports} Rap.</span>}
   107→            </div>
   108→          ))}
   109→        </div>
   110→      )}
   111→    </div>
   112→  );
   113→});
   114→
   115→export default CallsignInput;
   116→

> AGENT

Deployed. Here's what was added:

In both **Frequenzen** (LandMode) and **OE-Link** (BundMode) entry forms, after the Rufzeichen input there are now two editable fields:

- **Name** — auto-populates when an operator is selected from autocomplete; if you type/edit and tab away, it immediately PATCHes the operator record
- **QTH** — same behavior, saves on blur

When the callsign input is cleared/changed manually, both fields reset. The fields are hidden on mobile (`hidden sm:block`) to keep the compact layout.

    19→  exerciseId: string;
    20→  repeaters: any[];
    21→  reports: any[];
    22→  onReportCreated: (report: any) => void;
    23→  onReportUpdated: (report: any) => void;
    24→  onReportDeleted: (reportId: number) => void;
    25→}
    26→
    27→interface EntryForm {
    28→  callsign: string;
    29→  operator: any;
    30→  rapport: string;
    31→  notes: string;
    32→  opName: string;
    33→  opQth: string;
    34→}
    35→
    36→export default function LandMode({ exerciseId, repeaters, reports, onReportCreated, onReportUpdated, onReportDeleted }: Props) {
    37→  const [collapsedReps, setCollapsedReps] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
    38→  const [opCallsigns, setOpCallsigns] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
    39→  const [bezirke, setBezirke] = useState<any[]>([]);
    40→  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
    41→  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '', opName: '', opQth: '' });
    42→
    43→  // Load bezirke + OP callsigns
    44→  useEffect(() => {
    45→    Promise.all([
    46→      apiFetch('/api/v1/reference/bezirke'),
    47→      apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/repeaters`),
    48→    ]).then(([bz, exReps]) => {
    49→      setBezirke(bz);
    50→      const ops: Record<number, string> = {};
    51→      for (const er of exReps) {
    52→        if (er.operator_callsign) {
    53→          ops[er.repeater_id] = er.operator_callsign;
    54→        }
    55→      }
    56→      setOpCallsigns(ops);
    57→    }).catch(() => {});
    58→  }, [exerciseId]);
    59→
    60→  // Group repeaters by Bundesland — exclude linked repeaters (those belong to BundMode)
    61→  const repeatersByBl: Record<string, any[]> = {};
    62→  const simplexRepeaters: any[] = [];
    63→  for (const r of repeaters) {
    64→    if (r.is_linked) continue;
    65→    if (r.type === 'simplex') {
    66→      simplexRepeaters.push(r);
    67→    } else {
    68→      const blCode = r.bundesland_code || '_other';
    69→      if (!repeatersByBl[blCode]) repeatersByBl[blCode] = [];
    70→      repeatersByBl[blCode].push(r);
    71→    }
    72→  }
    73→
    74→  const sortedBlCodes = Object.keys(repeatersByBl).sort((a, b) => {
    75→    if (a === '_other') return 1;
    76→    if (b === '_other') return -1;
    77→    return a.localeCompare(b);
    78→  });
    79→
    80→  const toggleRepeater = (repId: number) => {
    81→    setCollapsedReps(prev => {
    82→      const next = new Set(prev);
    83→      if (next.has(repId)) next.delete(repId); else next.add(repId);
    84→      return next;
    85→    });
    86→  };
    87→
    88→  const saveOpCallsign = async (repeaterId: number, val: string) => {
    89→    try {
    90→      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/repeaters`, {
    91→        method: 'POST',
    92→        body: JSON.stringify({ repeater_id: repeaterId, operator_callsign: val || null }),
    93→      });
    94→    } catch {
    95→      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/repeaters/${repeaterId}`, {
    96→        method: 'PATCH',
    97→        body: JSON.stringify({ operator_callsign: val || null }),
    98→      });
    99→    }
   100→  };
   101→
   102→  const parseRapport = (raw: string) => {
   103→    const match = raw.match(/^(\d)\/(\d)(.*)$/);
   104→    if (!match) return { readability: null, strength: null, db_over_s9: null };
   105→    return {
   106→      readability: parseInt(match[1]),
   107→      strength: parseInt(match[2]),
   108→      db_over_s9: match[3]?.trim() || null,
   109→    };
   110→  };
   111→
   112→  const handleBezirkSubmit = async (bezirkCode: string, repeaterId: number, form: EntryForm) => {
   113→    try {
   114→      const operator = await getOrCreateOperator(form.callsign, form.operator);
   115→      if (!operator) return;
   116→
   117→      // Set operator's bezirk_code to match the row they were entered in
   118→      if (bezirkCode && bezirkCode !== '??') {
   119→        apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators/${operator.id}`, {
   120→          method: 'PATCH',
   121→          body: JSON.stringify({ bezirk_code: bezirkCode }),
   122→        }).catch(() => {});
   123→      }
   124→
   125→      const parsed = parseRapport(form.rapport);
   126→
   127→      try {
   128→        const report = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports`, {
   129→          method: 'POST',
   130→          body: JSON.stringify({
   131→            operator_id: operator.id,
   132→            repeater_id: repeaterId,
   133→            ...parsed,
   134→            notes: form.notes || null,
   135→          }),
   136→        });
   137→        // Force bezirk_code on report so it shows in the correct row immediately
   138→        if (bezirkCode && bezirkCode !== '??') report.bezirk_code = bezirkCode;
   139→        onReportCreated(report);
   140→      } catch (err: any) {
   141→        if (err.message?.includes('existiert')) {
   142→          const existing = reports.find(r => r.operator_id === operator.id && r.repeater_id === repeaterId);
   143→          if (existing) {
   144→            const updated = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports/${existing.id}`, {
   145→              method: 'PATCH',
   146→              body: JSON.stringify({ ...parsed, notes: form.notes || null }),
   147→            });
   148→            if (bezirkCode && bezirkCode !== '??') updated.bezirk_code = bezirkCode;
   149→            onReportUpdated(updated);
   150→          }
   151→        }
   152→      }
   153→    } catch {}
   154→  };
   155→
   156→  const handleEdit = (report: any) => {
   157→    setEditingId(report.id);
   158→    setEditForm({
   159→      callsign: report.callsign,
   160→      operator: { id: report.operator_id, callsign: report.callsign },
   161→      rapport: report.readability && report.strength ? `${report.readability}/${report.strength}${report.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '',
   162→      notes: report.notes || '',
   163→      opName: report.operator_name || '',
   164→      opQth: '',
   165→    });
   166→  };
   167→
   168→  const handleUpdate = async () => {
   169→    if (!editingId) return;
   170→    const parsed = parseRapport(editForm.rapport);
   171→    try {
   172→      const updated = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports/${editingId}`, {
   173→        method: 'PATCH',
   174→        body: JSON.stringify({ ...parsed, notes: editForm.notes || null }),
   175→      });
   176→      onReportUpdated(updated);
   177→      setEditingId(null);
   178→    } catch {}
   179→  };
   180→
   181→  const handleDelete = async (reportId: number) => {
   182→    if (!confirm('Rapport löschen?')) return;
   183→    try {
   184→      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports/${reportId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
   185→      onReportDeleted(reportId);
   186→    } catch {}
   187→  };
   188→
   189→  const renderRepeaterCard = (rep: any) => {
   190→    const repReports = reports.filter(r => r.repeater_id === rep.repeater_id && !r.is_op_marker);
   191→    const reportCount = repReports.filter(r => r.readability).length;
   192→    const isCollapsed = collapsedReps.has(rep.repeater_id);
   193→    const repBezirke = bezirke.filter(b => b.bundesland_code === rep.bundesland_code);
   194→
   195→    return (
   196→      <div key={rep.repeater_id} className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm">
   197→        <div className="bg-gray-50 px-2 sm:px-3 py-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between border-b gap-1">
   198→          <div
   199→            onClick={() => toggleRepeater(rep.repeater_id)}
   200→            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 rounded px-1 -mx-1 min-w-0"
   201→          >
   202→            <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">{isCollapsed ? '▶' : '▼'}</span>
   203→            <span className="font-medium text-xs sm:text-sm truncate">{rep.short_name}</span>
   204→            <span className="bg-[#0d6efd] text-white text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full flex-shrink-0">{reportCount}</span>
   205→            {rep.frequency_mhz && (
   206→              <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 hidden sm:inline">{rep.frequency_mhz} MHz</span>
   207→            )}
   208→            {rep.offset_mhz && (
   209→              <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 hidden md:inline">({rep.offset_mhz > 0 ? '+' : ''}{rep.offset_mhz})</span>
   210→            )}
   211→            {rep.ctcss_hz && (
   212→              <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 hidden md:inline">CTCSS {rep.ctcss_hz}</span>
   213→            )}
   214→          </div>
   215→          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
   216→            <label className={`text-xs ${opCallsigns[rep.repeater_id] ? 'text-gray-500' : 'text-[#c8102e] font-semibold'}`}>OP:</label>
   217→            <input
   218→              type="text"
   219→              value={opCallsigns[rep.repeater_id] || ''}
   220→              onChange={e => setOpCallsigns(prev => ({ ...prev, [rep.repeater_id]: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))}
   221→              onBlur={e => saveOpCallsign(rep.repeater_id, e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
   222→              placeholder="Rufz."
   223→              className={`border rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono uppercase w-20 sm:w-24 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 ${opCallsigns[rep.repeater_id] ? 'border-gray-300' : 'border-[#c8102e] placeholder-[#c8102e]/60'}`}
   224→            />
   225→          </div>
   226→        </div>
   227→
   228→        {!isCollapsed && (
   229→          <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
   230→            {repBezirke.length > 0 ? (
   231→              <>
   232→                {repBezirke.map(bz => {
   233→                  const bzReports = repReports.filter(r => r.bezirk_code === bz.code);
   234→                  return (
   235→                    <BezirkRow
   236→                      key={bz.code}
   237→                      bezirk={bz}
   238→                      reports={bzReports}
   239→                      repeaterId={rep.repeater_id}
   240→                      onSubmit={(form) => handleBezirkSubmit(bz.code, rep.repeater_id, form)}
   241→                      onEdit={handleEdit}
   242→                      onDelete={handleDelete}
   243→                      editingId={editingId}
   244→                      editForm={editForm}
   245→                      onEditChange={setEditForm}
   246→                      onEditSave={handleUpdate}
   247→                      onEditCancel={() => setEditingId(null)}
   248→                    />
   249→                  );
   250→                })}
   251→                {/* Reports without matching bezirk */}
   252→                {(() => {
   253→                  const bzCodes = new Set(repBezirke.map(b => b.code));
   254→                  const unassigned = repReports.filter(r => !r.bezirk_code || !bzCodes.has(r.bezirk_code));
   255→                  if (unassigned.length === 0) return null;
   256→                  return (
   257→                    <div className="px-3 py-1.5">
   258→                      <table className="w-full text-xs mb-1">
   259→                        <tbody>
   260→                          {unassigned.map((r, idx) => (
   261→                            <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-blue-50 group">
   262→                              {editingId === r.id ? (
   263→                                <td colSpan={5} className="py-0.5">
   264→                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 rounded p-1">
   265→                                    <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   266→                                    <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => setEditForm({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20" autoFocus />
   267→                                    <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => setEditForm({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="Sonst." className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-20" />
   268→                                    <button onClick={handleUpdate} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   269→                                    <button onClick={() => setEditingId(null)} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   270→                                  </div>
   271→                                </td>
   272→                              ) : (
   273→                                <>
   274→                                  <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-400 w-4">{idx + 1}</td>
   275→                                  <td className="py-0.5 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleEdit(r)}>
   276→                                    <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   277→                                    {r.operator_name && <span className="ml-1 text-gray-500 text-xs">{r.operator_name}</span>}
   278→                                    {r.operator_qth && <span className="ml-1 text-gray-400 text-xs hidden sm:inline">{r.operator_qth}</span>}
   279→                                  </td>
   280→                                  <td className="py-0.5 font-mono text-gray-500 w-24 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleEdit(r)}>
   281→                                    {r.readability && r.strength ? `${r.readability}/${r.strength}${r.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '—'}
   282→                                  </td>
   283→                                  <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-500 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleEdit(r)}>{r.notes || ''}</td>
   284→                                  <td className="py-0.5 w-4">
   285→                                    <button onClick={() => handleDelete(r.id)} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">x</button>
   286→                                  </td>
   287→                                </>
   288→                              )}
   289→                            </tr>
   290→                          ))}
   291→                        </tbody>
   292→                      </table>
   293→                    </div>
   294→                  );
   295→                })()}
   296→              </>
   297→            ) : (
   298→              /* No Bezirke — flat list with input form */
   299→              <FlatReportRow
   300→                reports={repReports}
   301→                repeaterId={rep.repeater_id}
   302→                onSubmit={(form) => handleBezirkSubmit('', rep.repeater_id, form)}
   303→                onEdit={handleEdit}
   304→                onDelete={handleDelete}
   305→                editingId={editingId}
   306→                editForm={editForm}
   307→                onEditChange={setEditForm}
   308→                onEditSave={handleUpdate}
   309→                onEditCancel={() => setEditingId(null)}
   310→              />
   311→            )}
   312→          </div>
   313→        )}
   314→      </div>
   315→    );
   316→  };
   317→
   318→  return (
   319→    <div className="space-y-2">
   320→      {sortedBlCodes.map(blCode => {
   321→        const blReps = repeatersByBl[blCode];
   322→        const label = BUNDESLAND_NAMES[blCode] || 'Sonstige';
   323→        return (
   324→          <div key={blCode}>
   325→            <div className="px-1 mb-1 mt-2">
   326→              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide">{label}</span>
   327→            </div>
   328→            <div className="space-y-2">
   329→              {blReps.map(rep => renderRepeaterCard(rep))}
   330→            </div>
   331→          </div>
   332→        );
   333→      })}
   334→
   335→      {simplexRepeaters.length > 0 && (
   336→        <div>
   337→          <div className="px-1 mb-1 mt-2">
   338→            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Simplex</span>
   339→          </div>
   340→          <div className="space-y-2">
   341→            {simplexRepeaters.map(rep => renderRepeaterCard(rep))}
   342→          </div>
   343→        </div>
   344→      )}
   345→    </div>
   346→  );
   347→}
   348→
   349→interface BezirkRowProps {
   350→  bezirk: any;
   351→  reports: any[];
   352→  repeaterId: number;
   353→  onSubmit: (form: EntryForm) => void;
   354→  onEdit: (report: any) => void;
   355→  onDelete: (id: number) => void;
   356→  editingId: number | null;
   357→  editForm: EntryForm;
   358→  onEditChange: (form: EntryForm) => void;
   359→  onEditSave: () => void;
   360→  onEditCancel: () => void;
   361→}
   362→
   363→function BezirkRow({ bezirk, reports, repeaterId, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: BezirkRowProps) {
   364→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '', opName: '', opQth: '' });
   365→  const callsignRef = useRef<CallsignInputRef>(null);
   366→
   367→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   368→    e.preventDefault();
   369→    if (!form.callsign && !form.operator) return;
   370→    onSubmit(form);
   371→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '', opName: '', opQth: '' });
   372→    setTimeout(() => callsignRef.current?.focus(), 50);
   373→  };
   374→
   375→  const saveOperatorField = (field: 'name' | 'qth', value: string) => {
   376→    if (!form.operator?.id) return;
   377→    const original = field === 'name' ? (form.operator.name || '') : (form.operator.qth || '');
   378→    if (value === original) return;
   379→    apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators/${form.operator.id}`, {
   380→      method: 'PATCH',
   381→      body: JSON.stringify({ [field]: value || null }),
   382→    }).then(() => {
   383→      setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: { ...f.operator, [field]: value || null } }));
   384→    }).catch(() => {});
   385→  };
   386→
   387→  return (
   388→    <div className="px-2 sm:px-3 py-1.5">
   389→      {bezirk.code !== '??' && (
   390→        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 mb-1">
   391→          <span className={`text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white ${bezirk.is_capital ? 'bg-[#dc3545]' : 'bg-[#6c757d]'}`}>
   392→            {bezirk.code}
   393→          </span>
   394→          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 truncate">{bezirk.name}</span>
   395→          {reports.length > 0 && <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0">({reports.length})</span>}
   396→        </div>
   397→      )}
   398→
   399→      {reports.length > 0 && (
   400→        <table className="w-full text-xs mb-1">
   401→          <tbody>
   402→            {reports.map((r, idx) => (
   403→              <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-blue-50 group">
   404→                {editingId === r.id ? (
   405→                  <td colSpan={5} className="py-0.5">
   406→                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 rounded p-1 flex-wrap">
   407→                      <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   408→                      <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-16 sm:w-20" autoFocus />
   409→                      <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="Sonst." className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20" />
   410→                      <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   411→                      <button onClick={onEditCancel} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   412→                    </div>
   413→                  </td>
   414→                ) : (
   415→                  <>
   416→                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-400 w-4">{idx + 1}</td>
   417→                    <td className="py-0.5 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>
   418→                      <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   419→                      {r.operator_name && <span className="ml-1 text-gray-500 text-xs">{r.operator_name}</span>}
   420→                      {r.operator_qth && <span className="ml-1 text-gray-400 text-xs hidden sm:inline">{r.operator_qth}</span>}
   421→                    </td>
   422→                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono text-gray-500 w-16 sm:w-24 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>
   423→                      {r.readability && r.strength ? `${r.readability}/${r.strength}${r.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '—'}
   424→                    </td>
   425→                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-500 cursor-pointer hidden sm:table-cell" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>{r.notes || ''}</td>
   426→                    <td className="py-0.5 w-4">
   427→                      <button onClick={() => onDelete(r.id)} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">x</button>
   428→                    </td>
   429→                  </>
   430→                )}
   431→              </tr>
   432→            ))}
   433→          </tbody>
   434→        </table>
   435→      )}
   436→
   437→      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
   438→        <CallsignInput
   439→          ref={callsignRef}
   440→          value={form.callsign}
   441→          onChange={v => setForm(f => ({ ...f, callsign: v, operator: null, opName: '', opQth: '' }))}
   442→          onSelect={op => setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: op, callsign: op.callsign, opName: op.name || '', opQth: op.qth || '' }))}
   443→          className="w-24 sm:w-28"
   444→        />
   445→        <input
   446→          type="text"
   447→          value={form.opName}
   448→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, opName: e.target.value }))}
   449→          onBlur={e => saveOperatorField('name', e.target.value)}
   450→          placeholder="Name"
   451→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs w-20 sm:w-24 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 hidden sm:block"
   452→        />
   453→        <input
   454→          type="text"
   455→          value={form.opQth}
   456→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, opQth: e.target.value }))}
   457→          onBlur={e => saveOperatorField('qth', e.target.value)}
   458→          placeholder="QTH"
   459→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 hidden sm:block"
   460→        />
   461→        <input
   462→          type="text"
   463→          value={form.rapport}
   464→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))}
   465→          placeholder="5/9"
   466→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-16 sm:w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   467→          onKeyDown={e => {
   468→            if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
   469→              e.preventDefault();

   513→

   517→    if (value === original) return;

   297→                        editForm={editForm}
   298→                        onEditChange={setEditForm}
   299→                        onEditSave={handleUpdate}
   300→                        onEditCancel={() => setEditingId(null)}
   301→                      />
   302→                    );
   303→                  })}
   304→                  {/* Reports without matching bezirk — shown directly as list items */}
   305→                  {(() => {
   306→                    const bzCodes = new Set(blBezirke.map(b => b.code));
   307→                    const unassigned = blReports.filter(r => !r.bezirk_code || !bzCodes.has(r.bezirk_code));
   308→                    if (unassigned.length === 0) return null;
   309→                    return (
   310→                      <div className="px-3 py-1.5">
   311→                        <table className="w-full text-xs mb-1">
   312→                          <tbody>
   313→                            {unassigned.map((r, idx) => (
   314→                              <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-blue-50 group">
   315→                                {editingId === r.id ? (
   316→                                  <td colSpan={5} className="py-0.5">
   317→                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 rounded p-1">
   318→                                      <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   319→                                      <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => setEditForm({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20" autoFocus />
   320→                                      <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => setEditForm({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="Sonst." className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-20" />
   321→                                      <button onClick={handleUpdate} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   322→                                      <button onClick={() => setEditingId(null)} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   323→                                    </div>
   324→                                  </td>
   325→                                ) : (
   326→                                  <>
   327→                                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-400 w-4">{idx + 1}</td>
   328→                                    <td className="py-0.5 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleEdit(r)}>
   329→                                      <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   330→                                      {r.operator_name && <span className="ml-1 text-gray-500 text-xs">{r.operator_name}</span>}
   331→                                      {r.operator_qth && <span className="ml-1 text-gray-400 text-xs hidden sm:inline">{r.operator_qth}</span>}
   332→                                    </td>
   333→                                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono text-gray-500 w-24 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleEdit(r)}>
   334→                                      {r.readability && r.strength ? `${r.readability}/${r.strength}${r.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '—'}
   335→                                    </td>
   336→                                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-500 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleEdit(r)}>{r.notes || ''}</td>
   337→                                    <td className="py-0.5 w-4">
   338→                                      <button onClick={() => handleDelete(r.id)} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">x</button>
   339→                                    </td>
   340→                                  </>
   341→                                )}
   342→                              </tr>
   343→                            ))}
   344→                          </tbody>
   345→                        </table>
   346→                      </div>
   347→                    );
   348→                  })()}
   349→                </div>
   350→              </div>
   351→            )}
   352→          </div>
   353→        );
   354→      })}
   355→    </div>
   356→  );
   357→}
   358→
   359→interface BezirkRowProps {
   360→  bezirk: any;
   361→  reports: any[];
   362→  linkedRepeaters: any[];
   363→  defaultRepeaterId: number;
   364→  onSubmit: (repeaterId: number, form: EntryForm) => void;
   365→  onEdit: (report: any) => void;
   366→  onDelete: (id: number) => void;
   367→  editingId: number | null;
   368→  editForm: EntryForm;
   369→  onEditChange: (form: EntryForm) => void;
   370→  onEditSave: () => void;
   371→  onEditCancel: () => void;
   372→}
   373→
   374→function BezirkRow({ bezirk, reports, linkedRepeaters, defaultRepeaterId, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: BezirkRowProps) {
   375→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '', opName: '', opQth: '' });
   376→  const [repeaterId, setRepeaterId] = useState(defaultRepeaterId);
   377→  const callsignRef = useRef<CallsignInputRef>(null);
   378→
   379→  useEffect(() => {
   380→    if (defaultRepeaterId && !repeaterId) setRepeaterId(defaultRepeaterId);
   381→  }, [defaultRepeaterId]);
   382→
   383→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   384→    e.preventDefault();
   385→    if (!form.callsign && !form.operator) return;
   386→    if (!repeaterId) return;
   387→    onSubmit(repeaterId, form);
   388→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '', opName: '', opQth: '' });
   389→    setTimeout(() => callsignRef.current?.focus(), 50);
   390→  };
   391→
   392→  const saveOperatorField = (field: 'name' | 'qth', value: string) => {
   393→    if (!form.operator?.id) return;
   394→    const original = field === 'name' ? (form.operator.name || '') : (form.operator.qth || '');
   395→    if (value === original) return;
   396→    apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators/${form.operator.id}`, {
   397→      method: 'PATCH',
   398→      body: JSON.stringify({ [field]: value || null }),
   399→    }).then(() => {
   400→      setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: { ...f.operator, [field]: value || null } }));
   401→    }).catch(() => {});
   402→  };
   403→
   404→  return (
   405→    <div className="px-2 sm:px-3 py-1.5">
   406→      {bezirk.code !== '??' && (
   407→        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 mb-1">
   408→          <span className={`text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white ${bezirk.is_capital ? 'bg-[#dc3545]' : 'bg-[#6c757d]'}`}>
   409→            {bezirk.code}
   410→          </span>
   411→          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 truncate">{bezirk.name}</span>
   412→          {reports.length > 0 && <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0">({reports.length})</span>}
   413→        </div>
   414→      )}
   415→
   416→      {reports.length > 0 && (
   417→        <table className="w-full text-xs mb-1">
   418→          <tbody>
   419→            {reports.map((r, idx) => (
   420→              <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-blue-50 group">
   421→                {editingId === r.id ? (
   422→                  <td colSpan={5} className="py-0.5">
   423→                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 rounded p-1 flex-wrap">
   424→                      <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   425→                      <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-16 sm:w-20" autoFocus />
   426→                      <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="Sonst." className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20" />
   427→                      <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   428→                      <button onClick={onEditCancel} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   429→                    </div>
   430→                  </td>
   431→                ) : (
   432→                  <>
   433→                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-400 w-4">{idx + 1}</td>
   434→                    <td className="py-0.5 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>
   435→                      <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   436→                      {r.operator_name && <span className="ml-1 text-gray-500 text-xs">{r.operator_name}</span>}
   437→                      {r.operator_qth && <span className="ml-1 text-gray-400 text-xs hidden sm:inline">{r.operator_qth}</span>}
   438→                    </td>
   439→                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono text-gray-500 w-16 sm:w-24 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>
   440→                      {r.readability && r.strength ? `${r.readability}/${r.strength}${r.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '—'}
   441→                    </td>
   442→                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-500 cursor-pointer hidden sm:table-cell" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>{r.notes || ''}</td>
   443→                    <td className="py-0.5 w-4">
   444→                      <button onClick={() => onDelete(r.id)} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">x</button>
   445→                    </td>
   446→                  </>
   447→                )}
   448→              </tr>
   449→            ))}
   450→          </tbody>
   451→        </table>
   452→      )}
   453→
   454→      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
   455→        {linkedRepeaters.length > 0 && (
   456→          <select
   457→            value={repeaterId || ''}
   458→            onChange={e => setRepeaterId(parseInt(e.target.value))}
   459→            className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs max-w-[80px] sm:max-w-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   460→          >
   461→            {linkedRepeaters.map(r => (
   462→              <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
   463→                {r.site_name || r.short_name}
   464→              </option>
   465→            ))}
   466→          </select>
   467→        )}
   468→        <CallsignInput
   469→          ref={callsignRef}
   470→          value={form.callsign}
   471→          onChange={v => setForm(f => ({ ...f, callsign: v, operator: null, opName: '', opQth: '' }))}
   472→          onSelect={op => setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: op, callsign: op.callsign, opName: op.name || '', opQth: op.qth || '' }))}
   473→          className="w-24 sm:w-28"
   474→        />
   475→        <input
   476→          type="text"
   477→          value={form.opName}
   478→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, opName: e.target.value }))}
   479→          onBlur={e => saveOperatorField('name', e.target.value)}
   480→          placeholder="Name"
   481→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs w-20 sm:w-24 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 hidden sm:block"
   482→        />
   483→        <input
   484→          type="text"
   485→          value={form.opQth}
   486→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, opQth: e.target.value }))}
   487→          onBlur={e => saveOperatorField('qth', e.target.value)}
   488→          placeholder="QTH"
   489→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 hidden sm:block"
   490→        />
   491→        <input
   492→          type="text"
   493→          value={form.rapport}
   494→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))}
   495→          placeholder="5/9"
   496→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-16 sm:w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   497→          onKeyDown={e => {
   498→            if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
   499→              e.preventDefault();
   500→              setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: `5/${e.key}` }));
   501→            }
   502→          }}
   503→        />
   504→        <input
   505→          type="text"
   506→          value={form.notes}
   507→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))}
   508→          placeholder="Sonst."
   509→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs flex-1 min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[60px] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   510→        />
   511→        <button type="submit" title="Rapport speichern (Enter)" className="bg-[#c8102e] hover:bg-[#a00d24] text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs flex-shrink-0">
   512→          + ↵
   513→        </button>
   514→      </form>
   515→    </div>
   516→  );
   517→}

                      <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
                      <button onClick={onEditCancel} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-400 w-4">{idx + 1}</td>
                    <td className="py-0.5 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>
                      <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
                      {r.operator_name && <span className="ml-1 text-gray-500 text-xs">{r.operator_name}</span>}
                      {r.operator_qth && <span className="ml-1 text-gray-400 text-xs hidden sm:inline">{r.operator_qth}</span>}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono text-gray-500 w-16 sm:w-24 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>
                      {r.readability && r.strength ? `${r.readability}/${r.strength}${r.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '—'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-500 cursor-pointer hidden sm:table-cell" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>{r.notes || ''}</td>
                    <td className="py-0.5 w-4">
                      <button onClick={() => onDelete(r.id)} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">x</button>
                    </td>
                  </>
                )}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
        <CallsignInput
          ref={callsignRef}
          value={form.callsign}
          onChange={v => setForm(f => ({ ...f, callsign: v, operator: null, opName: '', opQth: '' }))}
          onSelect={op => setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: op, callsign: op.callsign, opName: op.name || '', opQth: op.qth || '' }))}
          className="w-24 sm:w-28"</tool_use_error>
```

     1→// Maps amateur radio callsign prefixes to bundesland/country codes used in the DB.
     2→// Austrian OE1-OE9 → "01"-"09", neighbor countries → "10"-"18".
     3→
     4→const PREFIX_MAP: [RegExp, string][] = [
     5→  [/^OE1/, '01'],
     6→  [/^OE2/, '02'],
     7→  [/^OE3/, '03'],
     8→  [/^OE4/, '04'],
     9→  [/^OE5/, '05'],
    10→  [/^OE6/, '06'],
    11→  [/^OE7/, '07'],
    12→  [/^OE8/, '08'],
    13→  [/^OE9/, '09'],
    14→  [/^HB0/, '16'],  // Liechtenstein (before HB!)
    15→  [/^HB/,  '17'],  // Schweiz
    16→  [/^S5/,  '10'],  // Slowenien
    17→  [/^OK/,  '11'],  // Tschechien
    18→  [/^OL/,  '11'],  // Tschechien
    19→  [/^D[A-R]/, '12'], // Deutschland
    20→  [/^I/,   '13'],  // Italien
    21→  [/^OM/,  '14'],  // Slowakei
    22→  [/^9A/,  '15'],  // Kroatien
    23→  [/^HA/,  '18'],  // Ungarn
    24→  [/^HG/,  '18'],  // Ungarn
    25→];
    26→
    27→/**
    28→ * Derive the bundesland/country code from a callsign.
    29→ * Strips portable/mobile suffixes (/P, /M, /OE8, etc.) before matching.
    30→ * Returns null if the prefix is not recognized.
    31→ */
    32→export function callsignToCountryCode(callsign: string): string | null {
    33→  // Strip suffixes like /P, /M, /OE8, /QRP etc.
    34→  const base = callsign.toUpperCase().replace(/\/.*$/, '');
    35→  for (const [re, code] of PREFIX_MAP) {
    36→    if (re.test(base)) return code;
    37→  }
    38→  return null;
    39→}
    40→

{
  "file_path": "/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/server/src/scripts/import-rufzeichen.ts",
  "content": "/**\n * Import/update operators from the Austrian Fernmeldebehörde Rufzeichenliste PDF.\n *\n * Usage:\n *   npx tsx src/scripts/import-rufzeichen.ts <path-to-pdf>\n *\n * Environment variables:\n *   RUFZEICHEN_MODE=update   — update existing records with new name/qth (default)\n *   RUFZEICHEN_MODE=skip     — skip existing records, only insert new ones\n */\n\nimport { execSync } from 'child_process';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport Database from 'better-sqlite3';\nimport { callsignToCountryCode } from '../utils/callsignCountry.js';\n\nconst MODE = (process.env.RUFZEICHEN_MODE || 'update').toLowerCase();\nif (MODE !== 'update' && MODE !== 'skip') {\n  console.error('RUFZEICHEN_MODE must be \"update\" or \"skip\"');\n  process.exit(1);\n}\n\nconst pdfPath = process.argv[2];\nif (!pdfPath) {\n  console.error('Usage: npx tsx src/scripts/import-rufzeichen.ts <path-to-pdf>');\n  process.exit(1);\n}\n\nconst resolvedPdf = path.resolve(pdfPath);\n\n// Extract text from PDF using pdftotext (poppler-utils)\nlet rawText: string;\ntry {\n  rawText = execSync(`pdftotext -layout \"${resolvedPdf}\" -`, {\n    encoding: 'utf-8',\n    maxBuffer: 50 * 1024 * 1024,\n  });\n} catch (err) {\n  console.error('Failed to run pdftotext. Make sure poppler-utils is installed.');\n  console.error('On NixOS: nix-shell -p poppler-utils --run \"npx tsx ...\"');\n  process.exit(1);\n}\n\n// Parse lines into records\ninterface RufRecord {\n  callsign: string;\n  name: string;\n  qth: string;\n}\n\nconst records: RufRecord[] = [];\nconst lines = rawText.split('\\n');\n\nfor (const line of lines) {\n  // Match lines starting with OE callsign pattern\n  const match = line.match(/^\\s*(OE\\d[A-Z0-9]{2,5})\\s{2,}(.+)/);\n  if (!match) continue;\n\n  const callsign = match[1].trim();\n  const rest = match[2];\n\n  // Skip redacted entries\n  if (rest.includes('*-*-*')) continue;\n\n  // Parse columns from the layout: Name is next, then Standort starts at a postal code\n  // Name: everything up to the first 4-digit postal code\n  // Standort: the postal code + city\n  const standortMatch = rest.match(/^(.+?)\\s{2,}(\\d{4}\\s+\\S.+?)\\s{2,}/);\n  if (!standortMatch) continue;\n\n  const name = standortMatch[1].trim();\n  const standortFull = standortMatch[2].trim();\n\n  // Extract just the city part from \"1180 Wien\" format for QTH\n  const qth = standortFull;\n\n  if (callsign && name) {\n    records.push({ callsign, name, qth });\n  }\n}\n\nconsole.log(`Parsed ${records.length} callsigns from PDF`);\nconsole.log(`Mode: ${MODE} (existing records will be ${MODE === 'update' ? 'updated' : 'skipped'})`);\n\n// Open database\nconst dbPath = process.env.DB_PATH || path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, '../../../../data/bosarsalog.db');\nconst db = new Database(dbPath);\ndb.pragma('journal_mode = WAL');\ndb.pragma('foreign_keys = ON');\n\n// Prepare statements\nconst selectOp = db.prepare('SELECT id, name, qth FROM operators WHERE callsign = ?');\nconst insertOp = db.prepare(`\n  INSERT INTO operators (callsign, name, qth, bundesland_code, updated_at)\n  VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))\n`);\nconst updateOp = db.prepare(`\n  UPDATE operators SET name = ?, qth = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\n  WHERE callsign = ?\n`);\n\nlet inserted = 0;\nlet updated = 0;\nlet skipped = 0;\n\nconst importAll = db.transaction(() => {\n  for (const rec of records) {\n    const existing = selectOp.get(rec.callsign) as { id: number; name: string | null; qth: string | null } | undefined;\n\n    if (existing) {\n      if (MODE === 'skip') {\n        skipped++;\n        continue;\n      }\n      // Update only if data actually changed\n      if (existing.name !== rec.name || existing.qth !== rec.qth) {\n        updateOp.run(rec.name, rec.qth, rec.callsign);\n        updated++;\n      } else {\n        skipped++;\n      }\n    } else {\n      const blCode = callsignToCountryCode(rec.callsign);\n      insertOp.run(rec.callsign, rec.name, rec.qth, blCode);\n      inserted++;\n    }\n  }\n});\n\nimportAll();\n\nconsole.log(`\\nResults:`);\nconsole.log(`  Inserted: ${inserted}`);\nconsole.log(`  Updated:  ${updated}`);\nconsole.log(`  Skipped:  ${skipped}`);\nconsole.log(`  Total:    ${inserted + updated + skipped}`);\n\ndb.close();\n"
}
