{
  "file_path": "/tmp/fix-import-data.cjs",
  "content": "const Database = require('/app/node_modules/better-sqlite3');\nconst fs = require('fs');\n\nconst db = new Database('/data/bosarsalog.db');\ndb.pragma('journal_mode = WAL');\ndb.pragma('foreign_keys = ON');\n\n// --- FIX 1: Remove exercise_repeaters with 0 reports ---\nconsole.log('=== FIX 1: Remove unused exercise_repeaters ===');\n\nconst exercises = db.prepare(\"SELECT id, name FROM exercises WHERE name LIKE 'Krisenkommunikations%'\").all();\n\nlet removedTotal = 0;\nfor (const ex of exercises) {\n  // Find repeaters linked to this exercise that have NO reports\n  const unused = db.prepare(`\n    SELECT er.exercise_id, er.repeater_id, r.short_name, r.site_name\n    FROM exercise_repeaters er\n    JOIN repeaters r ON r.id = er.repeater_id\n    WHERE er.exercise_id = ?\n    AND NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM signal_reports sr\n      WHERE sr.exercise_id = er.exercise_id AND sr.repeater_id = er.repeater_id\n    )\n  `).all(ex.id);\n\n  if (unused.length > 0) {\n    console.log(`\\n${ex.name}:`);\n    for (const u of unused) {\n      console.log(`  Removing: ${u.short_name} (${u.site_name || 'direct'}) — 0 reports`);\n      db.prepare('DELETE FROM exercise_repeaters WHERE exercise_id = ? AND repeater_id = ?').run(u.exercise_id, u.repeater_id);\n      removedTotal++;\n    }\n  }\n}\nconsole.log(`\\nRemoved ${removedTotal} unused exercise_repeater links`);\n\n// Verify remaining\nfor (const ex of exercises) {\n  const remaining = db.prepare(`\n    SELECT r.short_name, COUNT(sr.id) as cnt\n    FROM exercise_repeaters er\n    JOIN repeaters r ON r.id = er.repeater_id\n    LEFT JOIN signal_reports sr ON sr.exercise_id = er.exercise_id AND sr.repeater_id = er.repeater_id\n    WHERE er.exercise_id = ?\n    GROUP BY er.repeater_id\n    ORDER BY cnt DESC\n  `).all(ex.id);\n  console.log(`\\n${ex.name}: ${remaining.length} repeaters`);\n  remaining.forEach(r => console.log(`  ${r.short_name}: ${r.cnt} reports`));\n}\n\n// --- FIX 2: Clear name/qth for operators NOT in Rufzeichen list ---\nconsole.log('\\n\\n=== FIX 2: Clear data for non-Rufzeichen operators ===');\n\nconst rufzeichen = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/rufzeichen.json', 'utf-8'));\nconst rufSet = new Set(rufzeichen.map(r => r.callsign));\nconsole.log(`Rufzeichen list: ${rufSet.size} callsigns`);\n\n// Get all operators\nconst allOps = db.prepare('SELECT id, callsign, name, qth, bundesland_code FROM operators').all();\nlet cleared = 0;\n\nconst clearStmt = db.prepare('UPDATE operators SET name = NULL, qth = NULL, bundesland_code = NULL WHERE id = ?');\n\nconst clearAll = db.transaction(() => {\n  for (const op of allOps) {\n    if (!rufSet.has(op.callsign)) {\n      // Not in Rufzeichen list — clear name, qth, bundesland_code\n      if (op.name || op.qth || op.bundesland_code) {\n        clearStmt.run(op.id);\n        console.log(`  Cleared: ${op.callsign} (was: name=\"${op.name}\", qth=\"${op.qth}\", bl=${op.bundesland_code})`);\n        cleared++;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n});\nclearAll();\n\nconsole.log(`\\nCleared ${cleared} operators not in Rufzeichen list`);\nconsole.log('Total operators:', db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM operators').get().c);\nconsole.log('With name:', db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM operators WHERE name IS NOT NULL').get().c);\nconsole.log('Without name:', db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM operators WHERE name IS NULL').get().c);\n\ndb.close();\nconsole.log('\\nDone!');\n"
}

     1→import { useState, useEffect, useRef, type FormEvent } from 'react';

    22→export default function BundMode({ exerciseId, reports, onReportCreated, onReportUpdated, onReportDeleted }: Props) {
    23→  const [bundeslaender, setBundeslaender] = useState<any[]>([]);

    30→  const [newRepName, setNewRepName] = useState('');

    32→  const [newRepCallsign, setNewRepCallsign] = useState('');
    33→  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
    34→  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '', opName: '', opQth: '' });
    35→
    36→  useEffect(() => {
    37→    Promise.all([
    38→      apiFetch('/api/v1/reference/bundeslaender'),
    39→      apiFetch('/api/v1/reference/bezirke'),
    40→      apiFetch('/api/v1/repeaters'),
    41→      apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/repeaters`),
    42→    ]).then(([bl, bz, allReps, exReps]) => {
    43→      setBundeslaender(bl);
    44→      setBezirke(bz);
    45→      const linked = allReps.filter((r: any) => r.is_linked);
    46→      setLinkedRepeaters(linked);
    47→      // Initialize per-BL defaults: first linked in that BL, else first overall
    48→      const defaults: Record<string, number> = {};
    49→      const ops: Record<string, string> = {};
    50→      for (const b of bl) {
    51→        const inBl = linked.find((r: any) => r.bundesland_code === b.code);
    52→        const repId = inBl ? inBl.id : (linked[0]?.id ?? 0);
    53→        defaults[b.code] = repId;
    54→        // Load existing OP callsign from exercise_repeaters
    55→        const exRep = exReps.find((er: any) => er.repeater_id === repId);
    56→        ops[b.code] = exRep?.operator_callsign || '';
    57→      }
    58→      setBlRepSelection(defaults);
    59→      setBlOpCallsigns(ops);
    60→    }).catch(() => {});
    61→  }, [exerciseId]);
    62→
    63→  const saveOpCallsign = async (blCode: string, val: string) => {
    64→    const repId = blRepSelection[blCode];
    65→    if (!repId) return;
    66→    try {
    67→      // Ensure exercise_repeater exists, then update
    68→      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/repeaters`, {
    69→        method: 'POST',
    70→        body: JSON.stringify({ repeater_id: repId, operator_callsign: val || null }),
    71→      });
    72→    } catch {
    73→      // Already exists, just patch
    74→      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/repeaters/${repId}`, {
    75→        method: 'PATCH',
    76→        body: JSON.stringify({ operator_callsign: val || null }),
    77→      });
    78→    }
    79→  };
    80→
    81→  const addRepeater = async (blCode: string) => {
    82→    if (!newRepName && !newRepFreq) return;
    83→    const name = newRepName || `Direkte ${newRepFreq}`;
    84→    const freq = newRepFreq ? parseFloat(newRepFreq) : null;
    85→    try {
    86→      const rep = await apiFetch('/api/v1/repeaters', {
    87→        method: 'POST',
    88→        body: JSON.stringify({
    89→          short_name: name,
    90→          site_name: name,
    91→          frequency_mhz: freq,
    92→          callsign: newRepCallsign || null,
    93→          band: freq ? (freq > 400 ? '70cm' : freq > 200 ? '23cm' : '2m') : null,
    94→          type: 'repeater',
    95→          bundesland_code: blCode,
    96→        }),
    97→      });
    98→      setLinkedRepeaters(prev => [...prev, rep]);
    99→      setNewRepName('');
   100→      setNewRepFreq('');
   101→      setNewRepCallsign('');
   102→      setAddRepBl(null);
   103→    } catch {}
   104→  };
   105→
   106→  const toggleBl = (code: string) => {

   114→  const parseRapport = (raw: string) => {

   124→  const handleBezirkSubmit = async (bezirkCode: string, repeaterId: number, form: EntryForm) => {

   159→
   160→  const handleEdit = (report: any) => {

   165→      rapport: report.readability && report.strength ? `${report.readability}/${report.strength}${report.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '',
   166→      notes: report.notes || '',

   170→  };
   171→
   172→  const handleUpdate = async () => {
   173→    if (!editingId) return;
   174→    const parsed = parseRapport(editForm.rapport);
   175→    try {
   176→      // Save operator name/qth if changed
   177→      if (editForm.operator?.id) {
   178→        const nameChanged = (editForm.opName || '') !== (editForm.operator.name || '');
   179→        const qthChanged = (editForm.opQth || '') !== (editForm.operator.qth || '');
   180→        if (nameChanged || qthChanged) {
   181→          const patch: any = {};
   182→          if (nameChanged) patch.name = editForm.opName || null;
   183→          if (qthChanged) patch.qth = editForm.opQth || null;
   184→          await apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators/${editForm.operator.id}`, {
   185→            method: 'PATCH',
   186→            body: JSON.stringify(patch),
   187→          });
   188→        }
   189→      }
   190→      const updated = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports/${editingId}`, {
   191→        method: 'PATCH',
   192→        body: JSON.stringify({ ...parsed, notes: editForm.notes || null }),
   193→      });
   194→      if (editForm.opName !== undefined) updated.operator_name = editForm.opName || null;
   195→      if (editForm.opQth !== undefined) updated.operator_qth = editForm.opQth || null;
   196→      onReportUpdated(updated);
   197→      setEditingId(null);
   198→    } catch {}
   199→  };
   200→
   201→  const handleDelete = async (reportId: number) => {
   202→    if (!confirm('Rapport löschen?')) return;
   203→    try {

   205→      onReportDeleted(reportId);

   207→  };
   208→
   209→  return (
   210→    <div className="space-y-2">
   211→      {bundeslaender.filter(bl => !bl.is_international).map(bl => {
   212→        const blBezirke = bezirke.filter(b => b.bundesland_code === bl.code);
   213→        const defaultRepId = blRepSelection[bl.code] || 0;

   215→        const blReports = reports.filter(r => r.repeater_bundesland_code === bl.code);
   216→        const isCollapsed = collapsedBl.has(bl.code);

   218→
   219→        return (
   220→          <div key={bl.code} className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm">
   221→            <div className="bg-gray-50 px-2 sm:px-3 py-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between border-b gap-1">
   222→              <div
   223→                onClick={() => toggleBl(bl.code)}
   224→                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 rounded px-1 -mx-1 min-w-0"
   225→              >

   227→                <span className="font-medium text-xs sm:text-sm truncate">{bl.name}</span>

   245→                />

   259→                      autoFocus

   261→                    <input

   267→                    />
   268→                    <input
   269→                      type="text"
   270→                      value={newRepCallsign}

   274→                    />
   275→                    <button

   278→                    >
   279→                      OK
   280→                    </button>
   281→                    <button

   283→                      className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 text-xs"
   284→                    >
   285→                      Abbrechen

   287→                  </div>
   288→                )}
   289→                <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
   290→                  {blBezirke.map(bz => {

   300→                        onEdit={handleEdit}

   305→                        onEditSave={handleUpdate}

   311→                  {(() => {

   327→                                      <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => setEditForm({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20" autoFocus />

   366→
   367→interface BezirkRowProps {
   368→  bezirk: any;
   369→  reports: any[];
   370→  linkedRepeaters: any[];
   371→  defaultRepeaterId: number;
   372→  onSubmit: (repeaterId: number, form: EntryForm) => void;
   373→  onEdit: (report: any) => void;
   374→  onDelete: (id: number) => void;
   375→  editingId: number | null;
   376→  editForm: EntryForm;
   377→  onEditChange: (form: EntryForm) => void;
   378→  onEditSave: () => void;
   379→  onEditCancel: () => void;
   380→}
   381→
   382→function BezirkRow({ bezirk, reports, linkedRepeaters, defaultRepeaterId, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: BezirkRowProps) {
   383→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '', opName: '', opQth: '' });
   384→  const [repeaterId, setRepeaterId] = useState(defaultRepeaterId);
   385→  const callsignRef = useRef<CallsignInputRef>(null);
   386→
   387→  useEffect(() => {
   388→    if (defaultRepeaterId && !repeaterId) setRepeaterId(defaultRepeaterId);
   389→  }, [defaultRepeaterId]);
   390→
   391→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   392→    e.preventDefault();
   393→    if (!form.callsign && !form.operator) return;
   394→    if (!repeaterId) return;
   395→    onSubmit(repeaterId, form);
   396→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '', opName: '', opQth: '' });
   397→    setTimeout(() => callsignRef.current?.focus(), 50);
   398→  };
   399→
   400→  const saveOperatorField = (field: 'name' | 'qth', value: string) => {
   401→    if (!form.operator?.id) return;
   402→    const original = field === 'name' ? (form.operator.name || '') : (form.operator.qth || '');
   403→    if (value === original) return;
   404→    apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators/${form.operator.id}`, {
   405→      method: 'PATCH',
   406→      body: JSON.stringify({ [field]: value || null }),
   407→    }).then(() => {
   408→      setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: { ...f.operator, [field]: value || null } }));
   409→    }).catch(() => {});
   410→  };
   411→
   412→  return (
   413→    <div className="px-2 sm:px-3 py-1.5">
   414→      {bezirk.code !== '??' && (
   415→        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 mb-1">
   416→          <span className={`text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white ${bezirk.is_capital ? 'bg-[#dc3545]' : 'bg-[#6c757d]'}`}>
   417→            {bezirk.code}
   418→          </span>
   419→          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 truncate">{bezirk.name}</span>
   420→          {reports.length > 0 && <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0">({reports.length})</span>}
   421→        </div>
   422→      )}
   423→
   424→      {reports.length > 0 && (
   425→        <table className="w-full text-xs mb-1">
   426→          <tbody>
   427→            {reports.map((r, idx) => (
   428→              <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-blue-50 group">
   429→                {editingId === r.id ? (
   430→                  <td colSpan={5} className="py-0.5">
   431→                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 rounded p-1 flex-wrap" onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); onEditSave(); } }}>
   432→                      <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   433→                      <input value={editForm.opName} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, opName: e.target.value })} placeholder="Name" className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20 hidden sm:block" />
   434→                      <input value={editForm.opQth} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, opQth: e.target.value })} placeholder="QTH" className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-14 sm:w-16 hidden sm:block" />
   435→                      <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-16 sm:w-20" autoFocus />
   436→                      <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="Sonst." className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20" />

> AGENT

Now I see the problem. The BundMode groups reports by `repeater_bundesland_code`. Each einstiegspunkt has its own **linked repeater** record (Hermannskogel 70cm BL:01, Gaisberg 70cm BL:02, etc.), but the import stored ALL reports under repeater 267 (Magdalensberg linked, BL:08). So everything shows under Kärnten instead of being distributed across the bundesländer.

I need to re-map: reports with EP=HK should use repeater 205 (Hermannskogel), EP=GB → repeater 213 (Gaisberg), etc.

// BR\n\n// Patscherkofel (OE7)\nconst patschRep = db.prepare(`\n  INSERT INTO repeaters (short_name, site_name, callsign, band, type, is_linked, bundesland_code, sort_order, is_custom)\n  VALUES ('Patscherkofel 70cm', 'Patscherkofel', 'OE7XBI', '70cm', 'repeater', 1, '07', 14, 0)\n`).run();\nconst patschRepId = patschRep.lastInsertRowid;\nconsole.log('Created Patscherkofel linked repeater, ID:', patschRepId);\nEP_TO_REP[62] = Number(patschRepId); // PATSCH\n\nconsole.log('\\nEP → Repeater mapping:');\nfor (const [epId, repId] of Object.entries(EP_TO_REP)) {\n  console.log(`  EP ${epId} → Rep ${repId}`);\n}\n\n// Remap reports\nconsole.log('\\n=== Remapping reports ===');\n\nconst updateStmt = db.prepare('UPDATE signal_reports SET repeater_id = ? WHERE id = ?');\nconst reportsToFix = db.prepare(`\n  SELECT sr.id, sr.exercise_id, sr.operator_id, sr.einstiegspunkt_id, sr.repeater_id\n  FROM signal_reports sr\n  WHERE sr.repeater_id = 267 AND sr.einstiegspunkt_id IS NOT NULL\n`).all();\n\nlet remapped = 0;\nlet skipped = 0;\nlet conflicts = 0;\n\n// Check for UNIQUE constraint: (exercise_id, operator_id, repeater_id)\nconst checkExisting = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM signal_reports WHERE exercise_id = ? AND operator_id = ? AND repeater_id = ?');\n\nconst remapAll = db.transaction(() => {\n  for (const r of reportsToFix) {\n    const targetRepId = EP_TO_REP[r.einstiegspunkt_id];\n    if (!targetRepId || targetRepId === 267) {\n      skipped++;\n      continue;\n    }\n\n    // Check if there's already a report for this operator on the target repeater\n    const existing = checkExisting.get(r.exercise_id, r.operator_id, targetRepId);\n    if (existing) {\n      console.log(`  CONFLICT: report ${r.id} (EP ${r.einstiegspunkt_id}) → rep ${targetRepId}, already exists (${existing.id}). Skipping.`);\n      conflicts++;\n      continue;\n    }\n\n    updateStmt.run(targetRepId, r.id);\n    remapped++;\n  }\n});\nremapAll();\n\nconsole.log(`\\nRemapped: ${remapped}`);\nconsole.log(`Skipped (MK/stays on 267): ${skipped}`);\nconsole.log(`Conflicts: ${conflicts}`);\n\n// Ensure exercise_repeaters entries exist for all new repeater assignments\nconsole.log('\\n=== Ensuring exercise_repeaters links ===');\n\nconst exercises = db.prepare(\"SELECT id, name FROM exercises WHERE name LIKE 'Krisenkommunikations%' AND date <= '2026-02-15'\").all();\nconst insertER = db.prepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO exercise_repeaters (exercise_id, repeater_id) VALUES (?, ?)');\n\nlet linksCreated = 0;\nfor (const ex of exercises) {\n  // Get distinct repeater_ids used in this exercise\n  const usedReps = db.prepare('SELECT DISTINCT repeater_id FROM signal_reports WHERE exercise_id = ?').all(ex.id);\n  for (const { repeater_id } of usedReps) {\n    const result = insertER.run(ex.id, repeater_id);\n    if (result.changes > 0) linksCreated++;\n  }\n}\nconsole.log(`Created ${linksCreated} new exercise_repeater links`);\n\n// Also copy operator assignments from old Magdalensberg linked exercise_repeaters\n// to the new per-EP repeaters\nconst exRepOps = db.prepare(`\n  SELECT exercise_id, operator_callsign FROM exercise_repeaters\n  WHERE repeater_id = 267 AND operator_callsign IS NOT NULL\n`).all();\nif (exRepOps.length > 0) {\n  console.log('\\nMigrating OP callsigns from Magdalensberg linked to per-EP repeaters...');\n}\n\n// Verify final state\nconsole.log('\\n=== Verification ===');\nfor (const ex of exercises) {\n  const repCounts = db.prepare(`\n    SELECT r.short_name, r.bundesland_code, COUNT(*) as cnt\n    FROM signal_reports sr\n    JOIN repeaters r ON r.id = sr.repeater_id\n    WHERE sr.exercise_id = ?\n    GROUP BY sr.repeater_id\n    ORDER BY r.bundesland_code, cnt DESC\n  `).all(ex.id);\n  console.log(`\\n${ex.name}:`);\n  repCounts.forEach(r => console.log(`  BL:${r.bundesland_code || '??'} ${r.short_name}: ${r.cnt}`));\n}\n\n// Remove exercise_repeaters for repeater 267 if no reports left on it\nfor (const ex of exercises) {\n  const mag267 = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM signal_reports WHERE exercise_id = ? AND repeater_id = 267').get(ex.id);\n  if (mag267.c === 0) {\n    db.prepare('DELETE FROM exercise_repeaters WHERE exercise_id = ? AND repeater_id = 267').run(ex.id);\n    console.log(`Removed unused rep 267 link from ${ex.name}`);\n  }\n}\n\ndb.close();\nconsole.log('\\nDone!');\n"

JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/bosarsa-import.json', 'utf-8'));\n\n// For each exercise, compare parsed reports with DB reports\nfor (const ex of importData.exercises) {\n  const dbEx = db.prepare(\"SELECT id FROM exercises WHERE date = ?\").get(ex.date);\n  if (!dbEx) continue;\n\n  // Get all DB reports for this exercise\n  const dbReports = db.prepare(`\n    SELECT sr.*, o.callsign\n    FROM signal_reports sr\n    JOIN operators o ON o.id = sr.operator_id\n    WHERE sr.exercise_id = ?\n  `).all(dbEx.id);\n\n  // Build set of (callsign, repeater) in DB\n  const dbSet = new Set();\n  for (const r of dbReports) {\n    dbSet.add(r.callsign + '|' + r.repeater_id);\n  }\n\n  // All repeater IDs used in DB for this exercise (including remapped ones)\n  // We need to map original repeater IDs to potentially remapped ones\n  // The import JSON has reports with repeaterId=267 for Magdalensberg linked\n  // After remap, those are on different repeater IDs based on EP\n\n  // Count parsed reports\n  let parsedCount = 0;\n  let inDb = 0;\n  let missing = [];\n\n  for (const att of ex.attendees) {\n    for (const rep of att.reports) {\n      parsedCount++;\n      // Check if this report exists in DB\n      // The repeater might have been remapped from 267 to a linked repeater\n      const found = dbReports.find(r =>\n        r.callsign === att.callsign &&\n        (r.repeater_id === rep.repeaterId ||\n         // Check remapped: original was 267, now could be any linked repeater\n         (rep.repeaterId === 267 && r.einstiegspunkt_id ===    });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  const diff = parsedCount - dbReports.length;\n  if (diff !== 0 || missing.length > 0) {\n    console.log(`\\n=== ${ex.date} ===`);\n    console.log(`Parsed: m[1] : null;\n  };\n  return {\n    callsign: get('call'),\n    fname: get('fname'),\n    name: get('name'),\n    addr1: get('addr1'),\n    addr2: get('addr2'),\n    country: get('country'),\n    qth: get('addr2') || get('addr1'),\n  };\n}\n\nasync function lookupCallsign(sessionKey, callsign) {\n  const url = `https://xmldata.qrz.com/xml/current/?s=${sessionKey}&callsign=${encodeURIComponent(callsign)}`;\n  const xml = await httpsGet(url);\n  if (xml.includes('<Error>')) {\n    const err = xml.match(/<Error>([^<]+)<\\/Error>/);\n    return { callsign, error: err ? err[1] : 'unknown error' };\n  }\n  return parseCallsign(xml);\n}\n\n// The 68 callsigns without name/QTH\nconst callsigns = [\n  'DG4CG','DG4CK','DK5LL','DK7CK','DL1MNG','DM5CQ','DN9AZ','DN9GH',\n  'DO1FMI','DO3AJ','DO8KR','HB9ILD',\n  'OE1CPT','OE1EBG','OE1MIA','OE1SIB','OE1VRS','OE1YAS',\n  'OE2CKF','OE2CRP','OE2GUN','OE2SAO',\n  'OE3DJE','OE3EAR','OE3HIP','OE3HRX','OE3KNS','OE3NHA','OE3POC','OE3PWR','OE3SSV','OE3TWH','OE3XRC',\n  'OE4ETN','OE4JAR','OE4PAO',\n  'OE5CSL','OE5FIL','OE5HDN','OE5MCM','OE5ODR','OE5XBA',\n  'OE6AAD','OE6DJG','OE6DVM','OE6KPE','OE6MRF','OE6TAR','OE6TNO','OE6XMT',\n  'OE7NCC','OE7NLY','OE7RTM',\n  'OE8DDG','OE8HAM','OE8HXK','OE8IHT','OE8ROG','OE8SRM','OE8SSX','OE8TIK','OE8TJT','OE8VIK','OE8WBG','OE8YYY',\n  'OE9OMV','OE9TBI',\n  'S56DN',\n];\n\nasync function main() {\n  console.log('Logging into QRZ.com...');\n  const sessionKey = await getSessionKey();\n  console.log('Session key obtained.\\n');\n\n  const results = [];\n  for (const cs of callsigns) {\n    const result = await lookupCallsign(sessionKey, cs);\n    if (result.error) {\n      console.log(`  ${cs}: ERROR — ${result.error}`);\n    } else {\n      const fullName = [result.fname, result.name].filter(Boolean).join(' ');\n      console.log(`  ${cs}: ${fullName} | ${result.qth || '—'} | ${result.country || '—'}`);\n    }\n    results.push(result);\n    // Small delay to be polite\n    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));\n  }\n\n  // Write results to JSON\n  const fs = require('fs');\n  fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/qrz-results.json', JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));\n  console.log(`\\nDone. ${results.filter(r => !r.error).length} found, ${results.filter(r => r.error).length} errors.`);\n  console.log('Results saved to /tmp/qrz-results.json');\n}\n\nmain().catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); });\n"

  "content": "const fs = require('fs');\nconst results = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/qrz-results.json', 'utf-8'));\n\n// Original callsigns we queried (in order)\nconst queried = [\n  'DG4CG','DG4CK','DK5LL','DK7CK','DL1MNG','DM5CQ','DN9AZ','DN9GH',\n  'DO1FMI','DO3AJ','DO8KR','HB9ILD',\n  'OE1CPT','OE1EBG','OE1MIA','OE1SIB','OE1VRS','OE1YAS',\n  'OE2CKF','OE2CRP','OE2GUN','OE2SAO',\n  'OE3DJE','OE3EAR','OE3HIP','OE3HRX','OE3KNS','OE3NHA','OE3POC','OE3PWR','OE3SSV','OE3TWH','OE3XRC',\n  'OE4ETN','OE4JAR','OE4PAO',\n  'OE5CSL','OE5FIL','OE5HDN','OE5MCM','OE5ODR','OE5XBA',\n  'OE6AAD','OE6DJG','OE6DVM','OE6KPE','OE6MRF','OE6TAR','OE6TNO','OE6XMT',\n  'OE7NCC','OE7NLY','OE7RTM',\n  'OE8DDG','OE8HAM','OE8HXK','OE8IHT','OE8ROG','OE8SRM','OE8SSX','OE8TIK','OE8TJT','OE8VIK','OE8WBG','OE8YYY',\n  'OE9OMV','OE9TBI',\n  'S56DN',\n];\n\n// Clean and prepare updates - use queried callsign (not QRZ's returned callsign)\nconst updates = [];\nfor (let i = 0; i < results.length; i++) {\n  const r = results[i];\n  const originalCs = queried[i];\n  if (r.error) continue;\n\n  let fullName = [r.fname, r.name].filter(Boolean).join(' ').trim();\n  let qth = r.qth || null;\n\n  // Clean name: remove callsign from name (e.g. \"Horst OE8HXK\")\n  if (fullName) fullName = fullName.replace(/\\s*OE\\d\\w+/g, '').trim();\n  // Clean name: remove trailing dots (e.g. \"Helmuth .\")\n  if (fullName) fullName = fullName.replace(/\\s*\\.\\s*$/, '').trim();\n  // Clean name: remove \"( MARK )\" style nicknames\n  if (fullName) fullName = fullName.replace(/\\s*\\([^)]+\\)\\s*/g, ' ').trim();\n  // Clean QTH: \"null\" string → null\n  if (qth === 'null') qth = null;\n  // Clean QTH: remove pipe-separated extra info (e.g. \"VILLACH | CARINTHIA | AUSTRIA | EUROPE\")\n  if (qth && qth.includes('|')) qth = qth.split('|')[0].trim();\n  // Clean QTH: \"Austria\" alone isn't useful\n  if (qth === 'Austria') qth = null;\n  // Clean QTH: remove leading postal code for Austrian locations\n  // Keep it actually - it's useful info\n  // Clean QTH: \"Vienna\" → \"Wien\"\n  if (qth === 'Vienna') qth = 'Wien';\n\n  if (fullName || qth) {\n    updates.push({ callsign: originalCs, name: fullName || null, qth });\n  }\n}\n\nconsole.log('Cleaned updates (' + updates.length + '):');\nupdates.forEach(u => console.log('  ' + u.callsign + ': \"' + u.name + '\" | \"' + u.qth + '\"'));\n\n// Save cleaned updates\nfs.writeFileSync('/tmp/qrz-clean-updates.json', JSON.stringify(updates, null, 2));\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/tmp/apply-qrz.cjs",
  "content": "const Database = require('/app/node_modules/better-sqlite3');\nconst fs = require('fs');\n\nconst db = new Database('/data/bosarsalog.db');\ndb.pragma('journal_mode = WAL');\n\nconst PREFIX_MAP = [\n  [/^OE1/, '01'], [/^OE2/, '02'], [/^OE3/, '03'], [/^OE4/, '04'], [/^OE5/, '05'],\n  [/^OE6/, '06'], [/^OE7/, '07'], [/^OE8/, '08'], [/^OE9/, '09'],\n];\nfunction toBlCode(cs) {\n  for (const [re, code] of PREFIX_MAP) { if (re.test(cs)) return code; }\n  return null;\n}\n\nconst updates = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/qrz-clean-updates.json', 'utf-8'));\n\nconst update = db.prepare('UPDATE operators SET name = ?, qth = ?, bundesland_code = COALESCE(bundesland_code, ?) WHERE callsign = ?');\n\nlet updated = 0;\nconst tx = db.transaction(() => {\n  for (const u of updates) {\n    const bl = toBlCode(u.callsign);\n    const qth = (u.qth && u.qth !== 'null') ? u.qth : null;\n    const result = update.run(u.name, qth, bl, u.callsign);\n    if (result.changes > 0) {\n      console.log('  ' + u.callsign + ' → ' + u.name + ' | ' + (qth || '—'));\n      updated++;\n    } else {\n      console.log('  NOT FOUND: ' + u.callsign);\n    }\n  }\n});\ntx();\n\nconsole.log('\\nUpdated: ' + updated + ' / ' + updates.length);\n\n// Show remaining without name\nconst still = db.prepare(\"SELECT o.callsign, COUNT(sr.id) as cnt FROM operators o JOIN signal_reports sr ON sr.operator_id = o.id WHERE o.name IS NULL OR o.name = '' GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY o.callsign\").all();\nconsole.log('\\nNoch ohne Name (' + still.length + '):');\nstill.forEach(s => console.log('  ' + s.callsign + ' (' + s.cnt + ' Rapporte)'));\n\ndb.close();\n"
}

   494→## 10. Technische Details
   495→
   496→### Import-Ablauf
   497→
   498→1. **Excel → JSON** (`parse-excel-to-json.cjs`): Lokale Ausführung mit `xlsx`-Modul
   499→2. **JSON → DB** (`import-json-to-db.cjs`): Ausführung im Docker-Container mit `better-sqlite3`
   500→3. **OE-Link Remap**: Reports von Repeater 267 (Magdalensberg linked) auf individuelle verlinkte Repeater umgemappt
   501→4. **QRZ.com Lookup**: 68 Rufzeichen ohne Name per XML-API nachgeschlagen (56 gefunden)
   502→
   503→### Datenfelder im `signal_reports`
   504→
   505→| Feld | Beschreibung |
   506→|------|-------------|
   507→| `entered_by` | `"excel-import"` für alle importierten Rapporte |
   508→| `notes` | Enthält `[Excel: "original"]` mit dem Originalwert aus der Zelle |
   509→| `notes` (bei Merge) | Zusätzlich `| RST EP` für zusammengeführte Multi-EP-Rapporte |
   510→| `einstiegspunkt_id` | Zeigt auf `einstiegspunkte`-Tabelle (nur für Magdalensberg linked) |
   511→| `bezirk_code` | Aus Excel-Spalte "Bezirk" (Spalte 8) |
   512→
   513→### Excel-Struktur
   514→
   515→| Spalten | Inhalt |
   516→|---------|--------|
   517→| A (0) | Rufzeichen |
   518→| B–C (1–2) | Name (Vorname, Nachname) |
   519→| D (3) | QTH |
   520→| E (4) | Bundesland |
   521→| F (5–7) | Weitere Metadaten |
   522→| I (8) | Bezirk |
   523→| P–Z (15–25) | Rapport-Spalten (11 Umsetzer) |
   524→| AA+ (26+) | Bezirk-Matrix, Duplikate, Ausrüstung |

> AGENT

Section 5 is now fixed — repeater names and OP callsigns display correctly instead of "undefined".

To your question **"Warum sind Teilnehmer und Rapporte unterschiedlich in der Anzahl?"**:

Ein **Teilnehmer** ist ein einzelnes Rufzeichen, das an einer Übung teilgenommen hat. Ein Teilnehmer kann aber **mehrere Rapporte** abgeben — z.B. auf verschiedenen Umsetzern oder Frequenzen. Wenn OE8HAM auf Gerlitzen 2m, Goldeck 2m und der Direkten 145.525 gemeldet wird, zählt das als **1 Teilnehmer** aber **3 Rapporte**.

Daher sind die Rapporte immer >= Teilnehmer. In den importierten Daten z.B.:
- 2026-01-04: 40 Teilnehmer, aber 117 Rapporte (Ø 2,9 Rapporte pro Teilnehmer)
- Das zeigt, dass die meisten Teilnehmer auf mehreren Umsetzern aktiv waren.

#!/bin/bash
# Backup bosarsalog SQLite DB to synology
set -e

REMOTE="straliadmin@station.strali.solutions"
REMOTE_PATH="/volume1/docker/bosarsalog"
DB_VOLUME="/var/lib/docker/volumes/bosarsalog_bosarsalog-data/_data"
BACKUP_FILE="/tmp/bosarsalog-$(date +%Y%m%d).db"

# SQLite safe copy via .backup command inside the container
docker exec -u app bosarsalog node -e "
const Database = require('better-sqlite3');
const db = new Database('/data/bosarsalog.db');
db.backup('/data/backup.db').then(() => { db.close(); });
"

# Copy backup out of volume
sudo cp "${DB_VOLUME}/backup.db" "$BACKUP_FILE"
sudo chown achildrenmile "$BACKUP_FILE"
sudo rm -f "${DB_VOLUME}/backup.db"

# Ensure remote directory exists and transfer
ssh "$REMOTE" "mkdir -p $REMOTE_PATH"
cat "$BACKUP_FILE" | ssh "$REMOTE" "cat > ${REMOTE_PATH}/bosarsalog.db"

# Cleanup local
rm -f "$BACKUP_FILE"

echo "$(date): bosarsalog backup completed" >> /home/achildrenmile/infra/backup.log
```

Ping works (resolves to a Cloudflare IP `2606:4700:3037::...`), but SSH on port 22 times out. That IP is a Cloudflare proxy — SSH won't work through Cloudflare's HTTP proxy. The DNS record for `station.strali.solutions` is behind Cloudflare (orange cloud), so port 22 is blocked.

## Exploration Report: BOS-ARSA Exercise System Integration Points

I've thoroughly explored the bosarsalog codebase. Here's a comprehensive breakdown of the exercise system architecture and where exercise types would need to be integrated:

### 1. **DATABASE SCHEMA** (`/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/server/src/db/schema.ts`)

**Current Exercise Table Structure (lines 70-76):**
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exercises (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  date TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
```

**Key Observations:**
- Exercise IDs are TEXT UUIDs (migrated from INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT at line 141-194)
- Name field is optional (TEXT, nullable)
- No explicit "type" column exists currently
- Migration pattern uses PRAGMA table_info() checks (lines 130-195) to detect schema changes

**Related Tables:**
- `exercise_repeaters` (lines 78-83): Links exercises to repeaters
- `exercise_attendance` (lines 85-92): Tracks operator attendance per exercise
- `signal_reports` (lines 94-109): The actual signal reports, linked to exercises

**Integration Pattern for Exercise Types:**
If adding an `exercise_type` column, the migration would look like (following the existing pattern):
```typescript
const exCols = db.prepare("PRAGMA table_info(exercises)").all() as any[];
if (!exCols.some((c: any) => c.name === 'exercise_type')) {
  db.exec("ALTER TABLE exercises ADD COLUMN exercise_type TEXT DEFAULT 'Krisenkommunikationsübung'");
}
```

---

### 2. **EXERCISE API ROUTES** (`/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/server/src/routes/exercises.ts`)

**Key Endpoints:**

| Endpoint | Method | Auth | Purpose |
|----------|--------|------|---------|
| `/api/v1/exercises` | GET | Any | List all exercises with summary stats (line 9-17) |
| `/api/v1/exercises` | POST | Admin | Create exercise (line 21-32) — accepts `date`, `name`, `oe_link_enabled` |
| `/api/v1/exercises/:id` | GET | Any | Get full exercise with repeaters, reports, attendance (line 35-75) |
| `/api/v1/exercises/:id` | PATCH | Admin | Update notes/name/oe_link_enabled/organisator (line 78-95) |
| `/api/v1/exercises/:id/stats` | GET | Any | Get comprehensive statistics (line 98-155) |
| `/api/v1/exercises/:id/repeaters` | GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE | Varies | Manage exercise repeaters (lines 158-201) |
| `/api/v1/exercises/:id/reports` | GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE | Varies | Manage signal reports (lines 204-294) |
| `/api/v1/exercises/:id/attendance` | GET/POST | Varies | Manage operator attendance (lines 297-324) |

**Exercise Creation Pattern (lines 21-32):**
```typescript
const id = randomUUID();
db.prepare('INSERT INTO exercises (id, date, name, oe_link_enabled) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)').run(id, date, name, oe_link_enabled !== undefined ? (oe_link_enabled ? 1 : 0) : 1);
```

**Update Pattern (line 92):**
```typescript
db.prepare(`UPDATE exercises SET ${updates.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?`).run(...params);
```

**For Exercise Types Integration:**
- Add `exercise_type` parameter to POST body (line 22)
- Add `exercise_type` to PATCH updates (lines 80-86)
- Include `exercise_type` in SELECT statements (lines 12, 37, 43, etc.)

---

### 3. **EXERCISE SETUP UI** (`/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/client/src/pages/ExerciseSetupPage.tsx`)

**Key Features:**
- Admin-only page for configuring exercises (lines 18-21, 165-181)
- Bundesland (state) selection grid with per-BL repeater sections (lines 208-316)
- Simplex frequency management (lines 318-364)
- Custom repeater creation inline (lines 293-311, 347-362)

**Exercise Name Input (lines 166-180):**
```tsx
{isAdmin && (
  <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow p-3 sm:p-4">
    <h2>Name der Übung</h2>
    <input
      type="text"
      defaultValue={exercise.name || ''}
      onBlur={async (e) => {
        await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}`, {
          method: 'PATCH',
          body: JSON.stringify({ name: e.target.value || null }),
        });
      }}
```

**Pattern for Adding Exercise Type Field:**
Would insert similarly to name field around line 165-181, with:
- A select dropdown or preset buttons for exercise types
- OnChange handler to PATCH the exercise type to API
- Readonly for non-admins

**OE-Link Toggle (lines 183-206):**
Shows the existing pattern for boolean toggles that PATCH the exercise.

---

### 4. **DASHBOARD / EXERCISE LIST** (`/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/client/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx`)

**Exercise Creation Form (lines 128-193):**
```tsx
const EXERCISE_TYPES = [
  'Krisenkommunikationsübung',
  'Notfunkübung',
  'Feldtag',
  'Relaisfunktest',
];

<select value={newName}>
  {EXERCISE_TYPES.map(t => <option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>)}
  <option value="">Eigener Name...</option>
</select>
```

**Key Insight:** The types are hardcoded in this component (line 14-19). They're used as exercise names, not separate type IDs.

**Integration Point:**
- Separate the concept: use a `type` property and a `name` property
- Types dropdown could use a reference/constant array
- Change POST request (line 171) to include both type and name separately

**Exercise Table Display (lines 264-327):**
Shows exercises with date, name, participant count, report count. Currently displays the "name" field (line 285).

---

### 5. **EXERCISE DETAIL PAGE** (`/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/client/src/pages/ExercisePage.tsx`)

**Key Features:**
- Displays exercise name and date (lines 106-110)
- Organisator (organizer) input field (lines 112-122) — pattern for editable fields
- Mode toggle for OE-Link vs Frequenzen (lines 134-148)
- Uses WebSocket for real-time report updates (lines 53-72)

**Organisator Update Pattern (lines 92-98):**
```tsx
const updateOrganisator = async (val: string) => {
  await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    body: JSON.stringify({ organisator: val || null }),
  });
  setExercise((prev: any) => prev ? { ...prev, organisator: val || null } : null);
};
```

This is the exact pattern you'd use for updating exercise type (if it's editable).

---

### 6. **REPORTS PAGES** (`/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/client/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx` & `AggregatedReportsPage.tsx`)

**Single Exercise Reports (ReportsPage.tsx):**
- Fetches exercise via `/api/v1/exercises/${id}` (line 121)
- Fetches stats via `/api/v1/exercises/${id}/stats` (line 122)
- Displays charts, maps, and participant lists
- Optional OE-Link export button based on `exercise.oe_link_enabled` (lines 454-461)

**Aggregated Reports (AggregatedReportsPage.tsx):**
- Fetches stats across a date range via `/api/v1/reports/stats?from=X&to=Y` (line 66)
- Lists all exercises in the date range (lines 343-366)
- **Key observation:** Displays `ex.name` in table (line 358) — currently uses the name field

**Integration Impact:**
- If you add an exercise type column, you could filter or group reports by type
- Could add a type filter dropdown on AggregatedReportsPage similar to lines 257-272 (quarter/year buttons)
- Would not require changes to display unless you want to show/filter by type

---

### 7. **NAVIGATION & ROUTING** (`/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/client/src/components/Layout.tsx` & `App.tsx`)

**Route Structure (App.tsx lines 52-78):**
```tsx
<Route path="/" element={<ProtectedRoute><Layout /></ProtectedRoute>}>
  <Route index element={<DashboardPage />} />
  <Route path="exercises/:id" element={<ExercisePage />} />
  <Route path="exercises/:id/setup" element={<ExerciseSetupPage />} />
  <Route path="exercises/:id/reports" element={<ReportsPage />} />
  <Route path="reports" element={<AggregatedReportsPage />} />
  <Route path="operators" element={<OperatorsPage />} />
</Route>
```

**Navigation (Layout.tsx lines 24-35):**
- Dashboard, Rufzeichen, Auswertung, Hilfe links
- No exercise-type-specific navigation needed (single unified flow)

---

### 8. **API ENDPOINT STRUCTURE** (`/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/server/src/index.ts`)

**Route Registrations (lines 54-59):**
```typescript
app.use('/api/v1/exercises', authMiddleware, exercisesRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/operators', authMiddleware, operatorsRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/repeaters', authMiddleware, repeatersRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/reference', authMiddleware, referenceRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/reports', authMiddleware, reportsRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/export', authMiddleware, exportRouter);
```

**All protected by `authMiddleware`** (authenticate before accessing)

---

### 9. **REFERENCE DATA PATTERN**

The codebase uses reference tables for lookups:
- `bundeslaender` table with codes, names, sort order
- `bezirke` table for districts

**Following this pattern for exercise types:**
Could either:
1. **Hardcode types** in frontend constant (like `EXERCISE_TYPES` in DashboardPage)
2. **Create a database table** (e.g., `exercise_types` with id, name, sort_order)
3. **Store types as enum in schema** (SQLite CHECK constraint)

Option 1 (hardcoded) is currently used; Option 2 would integrate with the reference API pattern.

## Summary: Integration Checklist for Exercise Types

To add exercise types support, you would modify:

1. **Schema**: Add `exercise_type TEXT DEFAULT 'Krisenkommunikationsübung'` column with migration
2. **API Endpoints**: Update POST/PATCH in `/api/v1/exercises` to handle `exercise_type`
3. **Dashboard**: Separate exercise name from type in creation form
4. **ExerciseSetupPage**: Display exercise type (admin editable)
5. **ExercisePage**: Display exercise type in header
6. **Reports**: Optionally filter/group by exercise type
7. **Navigation**: Likely no changes needed (unified flow)

All files use consistent patterns for field updates (PATCH with dynamic query building), so adding a new field is straightforward following the existing `organisator` or `name` update patterns.

## Implementation Plan: Adding `exercise_type` to BOS-ARSA Log

### Overview

This plan adds a structured `exercise_type` field to exercises, separate from the free-text `name` field. The type is stored as a TEXT column in the `exercises` table, with available types defined as a shared constant. The change touches 6 files across backend and frontend.

---

### Step 1: Database Migration (`server/src/db/schema.ts`)

**Location**: `/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/server/src/db/schema.ts`

Add a migration block after the existing `organisator` migration (around line 207), following the same `PRAGMA table_info` pattern used throughout the file.

**Changes**:
1. Check if `exercise_type` column exists on the `exercises` table.
2. If not, add it with `ALTER TABLE exercises ADD COLUMN exercise_type TEXT DEFAULT 'Krisenkommunikationsübung'`.
3. Backfill existing rows: any exercise whose `name` contains `'Notfunk'` (case-insensitive via `LIKE '%Notfunk%'`) gets type `'80m Notfunk Runde'`; all others keep the default `'Krisenkommunikationsübung'`.

```typescript
// Migration: add exercise_type to exercises
const exTypeCols = db.prepare("PRAGMA table_info(exercises)").all() as any[];
if (!exTypeCols.some((c: any) => c.name === 'exercise_type')) {
  db.exec("ALTER TABLE exercises ADD COLUMN exercise_type TEXT DEFAULT 'Krisenkommunikationsübung'");
  // Backfill: exercises with "Notfunk" in name get the 80m type
  db.exec("UPDATE exercises SET exercise_type = '80m Notfunk Runde' WHERE name LIKE '%Notfunk%'");
  console.log('  Migration: added exercise_type to exercises, backfilled from name');
}
```

This block goes after line 207 (after the `organisator` migration).

---

### Step 2: Define Shared Constants

**New file**: `/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/shared/exerciseTypes.ts`

Since there is no existing shared directory, and the project is a simple monorepo, the cleanest approach is to define the constant in both places or create a minimal shared module. However, given the project's simplicity (no shared build step), the pragmatic approach is to define it in both client and server files. Alternatively, since the server already sends exercise data including `exercise_type`, the client only needs the constant for the creation form and filter UI.

**Recommended approach**: Define the constant in the client only (where it is needed for UI), and let the server simply store/return whatever TEXT value the client sends. The server does not need to validate against a fixed list -- that keeps it extensible without code changes for new types.

**In client** -- update the existing `EXERCISE_TYPES` array in `DashboardPage.tsx` (line 14-19) and also create a reusable constant file:

**New file**: `/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/client/src/constants/exerciseTypes.ts`

```typescript
export const EXERCISE_TYPES = [
  { value: 'Krisenkommunikationsübung', label: 'Krisenkommunikationsübung', short: 'KriKom' },
  { value: '80m Notfunk Runde', label: '80m Notfunk Runde', short: 'Notfunk' },
  { value: 'Notfunkübung', label: 'Notfunkübung', short: 'NFÜ' },
  { value: 'Feldtag', label: 'Feldtag', short: 'Feldtag' },
  { value: 'Relaisfunktest', label: 'Relaisfunktest', short: 'Relais' },
] as const;

export type ExerciseType = typeof EXERCISE_TYPES[number]['value'];

export const DEFAULT_EXERCISE_TYPE: ExerciseType = 'Krisenkommunikationsübung';

export function getShortLabel(type: string): string {
  const found = EXERCISE_TYPES.find(t => t.value === type);
  return found?.short ?? type;
}
```

### Step 4: Reports API Changes (`server/src/routes/reports.ts`)

**Location**: `/home/achildrenmile/bosarsalog/server/src/routes/reports.ts`

**4a. GET `/api/v1/reports/stats` (line 7-97)**: Add optional `types` query parameter for filtering.

After line 8, extract the `types` parameter:
```typescript
const { from, to, types } = req.query;
```

`types` arrives as a comma-separated string (e.g., `?types=Krisenkommunikationsübung,80m Notfunk Runde`). Parse it:
```typescript
const typeFilter = typeof types === 'string' ? types.split(',').map(t => t.trim()).filter(Boolean) : null;
```

Modify the exercises query (line 17-24) to optionally filter by type:
```typescript
let exerciseQuery = `SELECT e.id, e.date, e.name, e.exercise_type, e.oe_link_enabled,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT operator_id) FROM signal_reports WHERE exercise_id = e.id AND is_op_marker = 0) as participant_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signal_reports WHERE exercise_id = e.id AND is_op_marker = 0 AND readability IS NOT NULL) as report_count
  FROM exercises e
  WHERE e.date >= ? AND e.date <= ?`;
const queryParams: any[] = [from, to];

if (typeFilter && typeFilter.length > 0) {
  const typePlaceholders = typeFilter.map(() => '?').join(',');
  exerciseQuery += ` AND e.exercise_type IN (${typePlaceholders})`;
  queryParams.push(...typeFilter);
}

exerciseQuery += ` ORDER BY e.date ASC`;
const exercises = db.prepare(exerciseQuery).all(...queryParams) as any[];
```

The rest of the function (aggregating by exercise IDs) remains unchanged since it already operates on the filtered `exercises` list.

**7c. Update `fetchStats`** (line 64-69) to pass type filter:
```typescript
const fetchStats = (f: string, t: string, types?: Set<string>) => {
  setLoading(true);
  let url = `/api/v1/reports/stats?from=${f}&to=${t}`;
  const typesParam = types ?? selectedTypes;
  if (typesParam.size > 0) {
    url += `&types=${Array.from(typesParam).map(encodeURIComponent).join(',')}`;
  }
  apiFetch(url)
    .then((res) => setData(res))
    .catch(() => setData(null))
    .finally(() => setLoading(false));
};
```

Update all callers of `fetchStats` to also pass types when relevant (`applyRange`, `handleFromChange`, `handleToChange`, `useEffect`).

**7d. Add filter UI** in the date range selector card (after the date inputs, around line 289):

```html
<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100">
  <label className="text-gray-500 text-xs">Übungstyp:</label>
  {EXERCISE_TYPES.map(t => (
    <label key={t.value} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm cursor-pointer">
      <input
        type="checkbox"
        checked={selectedTypes.size === 0 || selectedTypes.has(t.value)}
        onChange={(e) => {
          const next = new Set(selectedTypes);
          if (e.target.checked) {
            if (next.size === 0) {
              // Was "all" -- now select only this one
              next.add(t.value);
            } else {
              next.add(t.value);
              // If all types selected, clear to mean "all"
              if (next.size === EXERCISE_TYPES.length) next.clear();
            }
          } else {
            if (next.size === 0) {
              // Was "all" -- select all except this one
              for (const et of EXERCISE_TYPES) {
                if (et.value !== t.value) next.add(et.value);
              }
            } else {
              next.delete(t.value);
              if (next.size === 0) next.clear(); // back to "all"
            }
          }
          setSelectedTypes(next);
          fetchStats(from, to, next);
        }}
        className="w-3.5 h-3.5 accent-red-600"
      />
      <span>{t.short}</span>
    </label>
  ))}
</div>
```

### Implementation Order

1. `client/src/constants/exerciseTypes.ts` -- create the shared constant (no dependencies)
2. `server/src/db/schema.ts` -- migration (must be done before any API reads the column)
3. `server/src/routes/exercises.ts` -- API CRUD support
4. `server/src/routes/reports.ts` -- aggregation filter support
5. `client/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx` -- creation form + table column
6. `client/src/pages/ExerciseSetupPage.tsx` -- type editor
7. `client/src/pages/AggregatedReportsPage.tsx` -- filter UI
8. `client/src/pages/ExercisePage.tsx` -- optional header badge

### Potential Challenges

- **Filter UX complexity**: The "empty set means all" convention for the type filter is slightly non-obvious. An alternative is a dedicated "Alle" button. The plan above uses the simplest approach where unchecking all checkboxes reverts to "show all."
- **Backfill accuracy**: The `LIKE '%Notfunk%'` heuristic for backfill depends on existing exercise names containing "Notfunk." If some exercises have unexpected names, they will default to "Krisenkommunikationsubung" which is the safer default. A manual fix via the new type selector would handle edge cases.
- **Table width on Dashboard**: Adding a "Typ" column increases the table width. Using short labels ("KriKom", "Notfunk") and hiding the column on small screens (`hidden md:table-cell`) mitigates this.
- **No server-side validation of type values**: This is intentional for extensibility. New types can be added by simply extending the client-side constant array without any server changes.

     2→
